                label += fragment
        label = label.removeprefix("其中：").rstrip("：:")
        if label.startswith("按商品转让的时间分") and label.endswith("类"):
            label = "按商品转让的时间分类"
        if label in headings:
            dim, basis = headings[label]
        elif label in {"合计", "总计"} and dim != "revenue_timing":
            dim = "business_segment"
        elif basis == "业务类型":
            dim = "product"
        if not dim or not amounts or not label or "年度报告" in label:
            continue
        used = set()
        for amount in amounts:
            center = (amount.start() + amount.end()) / 2
            col = (
                amounts.index(amount)
                if len(amounts) == len(centers)
                else min(range(len(centers)), key=lambda i: abs(centers[i] - center))
            )
            # Costs are never silently shifted into an empty revenue column.
            if col % 2 or col in used:
                continue
            used.add(col)
            column_name = names[col // 2]
            rows.append(
                (
                    dim,
                    label,
                    amount.group(),
                    "合同收入/"
                    + (
                        "合同分解合计"
                        if label in {"合计", "总计"} and dim != "revenue_timing"
                        else basis
                    ),
                    None,
                    "原收入列：" + column_name + "营业收入",
                )
            )
    return rows


def _real_estate_settlement_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Read printed project settlement income, including zero and wrapped names."""
    rows = []
    sales = re.search(r"报告期内房地产销售和结转情况", re.sub(r"[ \t]+", "", text))
    if sales:
        native_heading = re.search(
            r"报\s*告\s*期\s*内\s*房\s*地\s*产\s*销\s*售\s*和\s*结\s*转\s*情\s*况", text
        )
        if native_heading:
            text = text[native_heading.start() :]
    if "出租房地产的租" in re.sub(r"\s+", "", text) and "结转收入金额" not in text:
        if "经营业态" in text and not re.search(r"项目\s+经营业态", text):
            for m in re.finditer(
                r"(?m)^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})\s+\d",
                text,
            ):
                rows.append(
                    (
                        "lease",
                        m[2],
                        m[3],
                        "房地产出租/租金收入",
                        None,
                        "原地区：" + m[1],
                    )
                )
            return rows
        rental = re.sub(r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*$", "", text)
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*\d+\s+[^\s]+\s+(.+?)\s+\S+\s+\d[\d,]*\.\d+\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d+)\s+\d+%?\s+",
            rental,
        ):
            name = re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1])
            tail = re.match(
                r"[ \t]*(基地)[ \t]*(?=\n|$)", rental[rental.find("\n", m.end()) + 1 :]
            )
            if tail:
                name += tail[1]
            rows.append(("lease", name, m[2], "房地产出租/租金收入", None))
        return rows
    if "结转收入金额" in text and re.search(r"销售、出租", text):
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*\d+\s+[^\s]+\s+(.+?)\s+(?:销售、出租|销售)\s+((?:[\d,.]+\s+){4}[\d,.]+)\s*$",
            text,
        ):
            rows.append(
                (
                    "project",
                    re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]),
                    m[2].split()[3],
                    "房地产销售和结转/结转收入金额",
                    None,
                )
            )
    if "结转收入金额" in text and re.search(r"商品房|经适房", text):
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*\d+\s+[^\s]+\s+(\S+)\s+(?:商品房|经适房)\s+((?:[\d,]+\.\d{2}|-)(?:\s+(?:[\d,]+\.\d{2}|-)){4})\s*$",
            text,
        ):
            amount = m[2].split()[3]
            if amount != "-":
                rows.append(
                    ("product", m[1], amount, "房地产销售和结转/结转收入金额", None)
                )
        return rows
    if "结转收入金额" in text and re.search(r"住宅|商住|商办|综合体", text):
        lines = text.splitlines()
        heading = next((l for l in lines if "结转收入金额" in l), "")
        amount_col = heading.find("结转收入金额")
        if amount_col >= 0 and re.search(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", text):
            # Calibrate the revenue cell on complete rows; its right edge is
            # stable even when the settlement-area cell is empty.
            complete = []
            for line in lines:
                m = re.match(
                    r"\s*\d+\s+\S+\s+(.+?)\s+(?:住宅|商住|商办|综合体)\s+", line
                )
                if m:
                    ns = list(re.finditer(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", line[m.end() :]))
                    if len(ns) >= 4:
                        complete.append((lines.index(line), m.end() + ns[3].end()))
            for index, line in enumerate(lines):
                right = (
                    min(complete, key=lambda pair: abs(pair[0] - index))[1]
                    if complete
                    else None
                )
                m = re.match(
                    r"\s*\d+\s+\S+\s+(.+?)\s+(?:住宅|商住|商办|综合体)\s+", line
                )
                if not m or right is None:
                    continue
                ns = list(re.finditer(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", line[m.end() :]))
                cell = next(
                    (n for n in ns if abs(m.end() + n.end() - right) <= 3), None
                )
                if cell:
                    rows.append(
                        (
                            "product",
                            re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1])
                            + (
                                re.sub(r"\s+", "", lines[index + 1]).split("住宅")[0]
                                if "（" in m[1]
                                and "）" not in m[1]
                                and index + 1 < len(lines)
                                and re.fullmatch(
                                    r"\s*[\u4e00-\u9fff]+[）)]\s*", lines[index + 1]
                                )
                                else ""
                            ),
                            cell.group(),
                            "房地产销售和结转/结转收入金额",
                            None,
                        )
                    )
            if rows:
                return rows
    current = None

    def flush():
        if current:
            rows.append(
                (
                    "project",
                    current[0],
                    current[1],
                    "房地产销售和结转/结转收入金额",
                    None,
                )
            )

    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(
            r"\s*\d+\s+[\u4e00-\u9fff]+\s+(?P<name>.+?)\s+(?:住宅(?:（含底商）)?|住宅、商业|商业)\s+(?P<cells>-?[\d,]+(?:\s+-?[\d,]+){4})\s*$",
            line,
        )
        if m:
            flush()
            current = [re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["name"]), m["cells"].split()[-2]]
        elif current:
            # Only a label fragment in the project's own first cell continues.
            fragment = re.match(
                r"^\s{8,}([\u4e00-\u9fffA-Z、]+(?: +[A-Z] +[\u4e00-\u9fff]+)?)\s*$",
                line,
            )
            if fragment:
                current[0] += re.sub(r"\s+", "", fragment[1])
    flush()
    m = re.search(r"实现结转收入金额\s*([\d,]+)\s*万元", text)
    if m:
        rows.append(
            (
                "business_type",
                "房地产结转收入合计",
                m[1],
                "房地产销售和结转/本期合计",
                None,
            )
        )
    return rows


def _native_company_columns(text: str) -> list[tuple] | None:
    """Keep wrapped names and business cells in their printed company columns."""
    lines = text.replace("\r", "").splitlines()
    heading = next(
        (
            i
            for i, line in enumerate(lines)
            if re.search(r"公司名称\s{2,}公司(?:类型)?\s{2,}主要(?:业务)?", line)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if heading is None:
        return None
    body = lines[heading + 1 :]
    end = next(
        (
            i
            for i, line in enumerate(body)
            if re.search(
                r"报告期内取得和处置子公司的情况|其他说明：|公司主要从事|公司及子公司主要产品|^\s*[［\[]?注[］\]]?：|^\s*2[.]本期对公司|\s指\s",
                line,
            )
        ),
        len(body),
    )
    body = body[:end]
    kind_column = next(
        (
            re.search(r"子公司|子公|参股公司|参股", line).start()
            for line in body
            if re.search(r"子公司|子公|参股公司|参股", line)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if kind_column is None or kind_column < 2:
        return None
    business_column = min(
        lines[heading].index("主要"),
        min(
            m.end()
            for line in body
            if (m := re.search(r"(?:子公司|子公|参股公司|参股)\s+", line))
        ),
    )
    groups = []
    current = None
    for i, line in enumerate(body):
        if re.search(r"年度报告|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+", line):
            continue
        row_kind = re.search(r"子公司|子公|参股公司|参股", line)
        name_end = row_kind.start() if row_kind else kind_column
        fragment = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[:name_end])
        fragment = re.sub(r"［注］|\[注\]|^注$", "", fragment)
        if fragment in {"类", "型", "类型"} and current is None:
            continue
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z•·（）()]*", fragment):
            fragment = ""
        if fragment and (
            current is None or current[0].endswith("公司") or row_kind and current[1]
        ):
            if current:
                groups.append(current)
            current = [fragment, "", [], i]
        elif fragment and current:
            current[0] += fragment
        kind = re.search(r"子公司|子公|参股公司|参股", line)
        if kind and current:
            current[1] = "参股公司" if kind.group().startswith("参股") else "子公司"
            current[2] = re.findall(
                r"-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d{2})?", line[kind.end() :]
            )
    if current:
        groups.append(current)
    starts = []
    for _, _, _, start in groups:
        begin = start
        while begin and not body[begin - 1][:kind_column].strip():
            lead = body[begin - 1][business_column:].strip()
            if not lead or re.search(r"年度报告|\d+\s*/\s*\d+", lead):
                break
            if not lead.endswith(("、", "，", "的", "种")) and not (
                len(lead) >= 9
                and "、" in lead
                and not re.search(r"贸易|服务|研发|销售|等|；|，", lead)
            ):
                break
            begin -= 1
        if start >= 2 and not body[start - 2][:kind_column].strip():
            lead = re.sub(r"\s+", "", body[start - 2][business_column:])
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12}的种", lead):
                begin = start - 2
        starts.append(begin)
    result = []
    for j, (name, kind, amounts, start) in enumerate(groups):
        stop = starts[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(groups) else len(body)
        # Business cells can start one line above the wrapped actor cell.
        branches = []
        for line in body[starts[j] : stop]:
            if re.search(r"年度报告|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+", line):
                continue
            cell = line[business_column:]
            cell = re.split(r"(?:USD|EUR|港币)?\s*-?\d", cell, maxsplit=1)[0]
            cell = cell.removesuffix("港币")
            branches.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "", cell))
        if kind and name:
            result.append((name, kind, "".join(branches), amounts))
    return result


def _native_company_table_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Read each company row independently; a blank income cannot borrow later."""
    if not re.search(
        r"注册资本\s+总资产\s+净资产\s+营业收入\s+营业利润\s+净利润", text
    ):
        return []
    columns = _native_company_columns(text)
    if columns is not None:
        return [
            (
                "business_segment",
                name,
                amounts[3],
                "控股参股公司/营业收入",
                None,
                kind + "：" + name,
            )
            for name, kind, _, amounts in columns
            if len(amounts) == 6
        ]
    table = re.split(r"营业利润\s+净利润", text, maxsplit=1)[1]
    table = re.split(r"报告期内取得和处置子公司的情况", table, maxsplit=1)[0]
    lines = table.splitlines()
    rows = []
    current = None

    def flush():
        if current is None:
            return
        name, kind, amounts = current
        # The six native columns are capital, assets, equity, income and profits.
        # Five values explicitly lack income; never search the following row.
        if name and len(amounts) == 6:
            rows.append(
                (
                    "business_segment",
                    name,
                    amounts[3],
                    "控股参股公司/营业收入",
                    None,
                    kind + "：" + name,
                )
            )

    for line in lines:
        kind = re.search(r"子公司|参股公(?:司)?", line)
        if kind:
            flush()
            native_name = line[: kind.start()].strip()
            name = re.sub(
                r"［注］|\[注\]",
                "",
                native_name
                if re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", native_name)
                else re.sub(r"\s+", "", native_name),
            )
            amounts = re.findall(
                r"-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d{2})?", line[kind.end() :]
            )
            current = [
                name,
                "参股公司" if "参股" in kind.group() else "子公司",
                amounts,
            ]
        elif (
            current
            and not current[2]
            and re.fullmatch(
                r"\s*(?:-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{2})?\s+){5}-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{2})?\s*", line
            )
        ):
            current[2] = line.split()
        elif (
            current
            and re.match(r"\s*[\u4e00-\u9fff]+", line)
            and not re.search(
                r"年度报告|单位|主要子公司|公司名称|^\s*名称|^\s*型$", line
            )
        ):
            # A wrapped company suffix occupies the first cell. The business
            # continuation may sit beside it and must not enter the actor.
            fragment = re.split(r"\s{2,}", line.strip())[0]
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]*公司|司", fragment) and not current[
                0
            ].endswith("公司"):
                current[0] += fragment
    flush()
    if not rows:
        # Native company tables declare six numeric columns. Keep the actor's
        # original row; legal scope remains qualified in its narrative evidence.
        joined = re.sub(r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*$", "", text)
        joined = re.sub(r"净利\s*润", "净利润", joined)
        joined = re.sub(r"参股公\s*司", "参股公司", joined)
        joined = re.split(r"营业利润\s*净利润", joined, maxsplit=1)[-1]
        joined = re.sub(r"^\s*名称\s*型\s*", "", joined)
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*(?P<name>[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z（）()]+(?:[ \t]+[A-Za-z]+)?(?:[ \t]*\n[ \t]*[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]+){0,2})\s+(?P<kind>子公司|参股公司)(?P<body>(?:(?!子公司|参股公司)[\s\S])+?)(?P<cells>(?:-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{2})?\s+){5}-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{2})?)(?=\s|$)",
            joined,
        ):
            cells = m["cells"].split()
            name = (
                m["name"].strip()
                if re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", m["name"])
                else re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["name"])
            )
            rows.append(
                (
                    "business_segment",
                    name,
                    cells[3],
                    "控股参股公司/营业收入",
                    None,
                    m["kind"] + "：" + name,
                )
            )
    return rows


def _native_industry_segment_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Read vertically wrapped industry columns without shifting empty cells."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    start = next(
        (
            i
            for i, l in enumerate(lines)
            if re.search(r"项目\s+[^\n]*行业", l) and "合计" in l
        ),
        None,
    )
    if start is None:
        return []
    cells = list(re.finditer(r"\S+", lines[start]))[1:]
    centers = [(m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in cells]
    labels = [[] for _ in cells]
    for l in lines[max(0, start - 1) : start + 2]:
        if "资产总额" in l:
            break
        for m in re.finditer(r"\S+", l):
            if m.group() == "项目":
                continue
            col = min(
                range(len(cells)),
                key=lambda k: abs(centers[k] - (m.start() + m.end()) / 2),
            )
            labels[col].append(m.group())
    names = ["".join(parts) for parts in labels]
    if not names or names[-1] != "合计" or not all("行业" in n for n in names[:-2]):
        return []
    # The continuation's full liabilities row establishes its own physical grid.
    full = next((l for l in lines[start + 2 :] if l.strip().startswith("负债总额")), "")
    ns = list(re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", full))
    if len(ns) != len(names):
        return []
    edges = [m.end() for m in ns]
    income = next(
        (l for l in lines[start + 2 :] if l.strip().startswith("营业收入")), ""
    )
    rows = []
    used = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", income):
        col = min(range(len(edges)), key=lambda k: abs(edges[k] - m.end()))
        if col in used:
            continue
        used.add(col)
        rows.append(
            (
                "business_segment",
                names[col],
                m.group(),
                "报告分部/营业收入",
                None,
                "原收入列：" + names[col],
            )
        )
    return rows


def _native_note_income_rows(text: str, title: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Read native income columns; identifiers in names never supply amounts."""
    if title == "年度主要业务数据":
        compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text)
        category = (
            "大宗商品经营"
            if "经营货量" in text
            else "大宗商品物流"
            if "大宗商品物流" in text
            else "生产制造"
        )
        actors = {}
        note = re.search(
            r"铁路物流、新能源物流、铝产业物流、农产品物流分别指公司子公司([^；]+?)对外提供",
            compact,
        )
        if note:
            actors.update(
                zip(
                    ("铁路物流", "新能源物流", "铝产业物流", "农产品物流"),
                    note[1].split("、"),
                )
            )
        owner = re.search(r"造船业务经营主体为公司子公司([^；。]+)", compact)
        if owner:
            actors["造船"] = owner[1]
        rows = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            m = re.match(
                r"\s*(?:其中：)?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)*\.?)?\s*([\u4e00-\u9fff]+)\s+([^\n]+)",
                line,
            )
            if not m:
                continue
            values = re.findall(r"-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?%?", m[2])
            col = 2 if category == "大宗商品经营" else 0
            if (
                len(values) < 6
                or values[col].endswith("%")
                or not values[col + 1].endswith("%")
            ):
                continue
            rows.append(
                (
                    "product"
                    if category == "大宗商品经营"
                    else "service"
                    if category == "大宗商品物流"
                    else "business_segment",
                    m[1],
                    values[col],
                    "年度主要业务数据/" + category,
                    None,
                    "原子公司：" + actors[m[1]] if m[1] in actors else None,
                )
            )
        return rows
    if title == "贸易业务收入":
        match = re.search(
            r"主要是开展各类(?P<names>[\u4e00-\u9fff\s]{2,50}?)等贸易业务\s+(?P<amount>\d[\d,]*)(?=\s)",
            text,
        )
        if match and not re.search(
            r"第三方|子公司|不存在|拟|计划|尚未", text[: match.end()]
        ):
            return [
                (
                    "trade",
                    re.sub(r"\s+", "", match["names"]) + "贸易",
                    match["amount"],
                    "本期营业收入",
                    None,
                )
            ]
        if re.search(r"[√✓]适用\s*□不适用", text) and "本期营业收入" in text:
            text = text.split("贸易业务开展情况", 1)[-1].replace("\r", "")
            # Rejoin a wrapped native row label before its three printed cells.
            text = re.sub(
                r"(?m)^([\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,45})[ \t]*\n[ \t]*([\u4e00-\u9fff、]{1,10})(?=\s+\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\s+\d)",
                r"\1\2",
                text,
            )
            return [
                (
                    "business_type",
                    m[1],
                    m[2],
                    "本期营业收入",
                    None,
                    "原子公司：" + m[1] if m[1].endswith("公司") else None,
                )
                for m in re.finditer(
                    r"(?m)^\s*([\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,45})\s+(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)\s+\d",
                    re.split(
                        r"贸易业务占营业收入|前五名|其他说明|\n\s*3、", text, maxsplit=1
                    )[0],
                )
            ]
        return []
    rows = []
    contract_rows = _native_contract_column_rows(text)
    if contract_rows is not None:
        rows.extend(contract_rows)
        text = re.split(r"合同分类|项目(?=\s{2,}分部\s{2,}合计)", text, maxsplit=1)[0]
    text = _join_native_income_cells(text)
    text = re.split(r"营业成本分解信息", text, maxsplit=1)[0]
    text = re.split(r"收入确认时间", text, maxsplit=1)[0]
    if "本期客户合同产生的收入情况如下" in text:
        timing = re.sub(
            r"在\s*某\s*一\s*时\s*(点|段\s*内)\s*确\s*认",
            lambda m: "在某一时" + re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]) + "确认",
            text,
        )
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"在某一时(点|段内)确认\s+((?:\d[\d,]*\.\d+\s+)+)", timing
        ):
            cells = m[2].split()
            rows.append(
                (
                    "revenue_timing",
                    "在某一时" + m[1] + "确认",
                    cells[-1],
                    "客户合同收入/确认时间/本期合计",
                    None,
                )
            )
    text = re.sub(
        r"((?:主营|其他)业务\s+(?:[-/]\s+){3}[-/])\s+(?=(?:主营|其他)业务)",
        r"\1\n",
        text,
    )
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*\n?", "", text.replace("\r", ""))
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)\s*,\s*(?=\d)", ",", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(\.\d{2})(?=-?\d)", r"\1 ", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*$", "", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(
        r"([\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,40})\n\s*(件|咨询和监理)\s*\n\s*(?=\d)",
        r"\1\2 ",
        cleaned,
    )
    cleaned = re.sub(r"中国\s*[(（]\s*含港澳\s*台\s*[)）]", "中国（含港澳台）", cleaned)
    lines = cleaned.splitlines()
    for i in range(len(lines) - 1):
        m = re.match(r"\s*(?P<label>[^\d\n]+?)\s+\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", lines[i])
        tail = lines[i + 1].strip()
        if (
            m
            and re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{1,2}", tail)
            and tail not in {"合计", "小计"}
        ):
            lines[i] = lines[i].replace(
                m["label"], re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["label"]) + tail, 1
            )
            lines[i + 1] = ""
    for i in range(len(lines) - 1):
        current, nxt = lines[i].strip(), lines[i + 1].strip()
        if (
            re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,40}", current)
            and current
            not in {
                "商品类型",
                "按经营地区分类",
                "主营业务收入",
                "其他业务收入",
                "主营业务成本",
                "其他业务成本",
                "合计",
            }
            and re.match(r"(?:服务(?:收入)?|发与销售|件|咨询和监理)\s+\d", nxt)
        ):
            lines[i + 1] = current + nxt
            lines[i] = ""
    cleaned = "\n".join(lines)
    main_only_regions = False
    main = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*主营业务\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})", cleaned)
    geography = re.search(r"按经营地区分类([\s\S]+?)(?=其他说明|履约义务|$)", cleaned)
    if main and geography:
        region_values = re.findall(
            r"(?m)^\s*(?:境内|境外)[^\d\n]*?(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})", geography[1]
        )
        main_only_regions = bool(region_values) and sum(
            Decimal(v.replace(",", "")) for v in region_values
        ) == Decimal(main[1].replace(",", ""))
    basis = ""
    dimension = ""
    segment_labels = []
    current_columns = (
        "合同分类" in cleaned and "营业收入" in cleaned and "营业成本" in cleaned
    )
    conventional_years = False
    aggregate_income_columns = False
    business_basis = ""
    # Join only printed note labels, never classification headings into a row.
    cleaned = re.sub(r"固定资产试\s*运行销售", "固定资产试运行销售", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?:其中：)?在某一\s*时点确认\s*\n", "在某一时点确认 ", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(
        r"(?:其中：)?在某一\s*时点确认\s*(?=\d)", "在某一时点确认 ", cleaned
    )
    cleaned = re.sub(r"在某一\s*时段确认\s*-\s*-\s*", "\n", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(
        r"固定资产试运行销售\s*\n\s*(?=\d)", "固定资产试运行销售 ", cleaned
    )
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*[-/]\s+[-/]\s+(?=(?:主营|其他)业务)", "", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"按商品转让的时间\s*分类", "按商品转让的时间分类", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"按商品转让的时\s*间分类", "按商品转让的时间分类", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"(?<=\.\d{2})\s+(?=合计\s+\d)", "\n", cleaned)
    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
        if re.search(
            r"公司前五名客户|客户名称|履约义务的说明|分摊至剩余履约义务|其他说明", line
        ):
            basis, dimension = "", ""
        compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line)
        if title == "项目销售收入":
            if "项目本期发生额上期发生额" in compact:
                current_columns = True
            dimension, basis = "project", "房地产销售收入"
        elif title == "贸易业务收入":
            if "贸易业务开展情况本期营业收入" in compact:
                current_columns = True
            dimension, basis = "trade", "本期营业收入"
        else:
            if compact == "营业收入和营业成本":
                basis, dimension = "营业收入", "product"
            if re.search(
                r"(?:主营|其他)业务收入(?:和(?:主营|其他)业务成本)?[:：]?$", compact
            ) or re.fullmatch(
                r"((?:主营|其他)业务收入(?:主营|其他)业务成本){2}", compact
            ):
                basis = "主营业务收入" if "主营业务收入" in compact else "其他业务收入"
                dimension = "product"
            elif re.search(r"(?:主营|其他)业务成本$", compact):
                basis, dimension = "", ""
            if "按商品转让的时间分类" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "收入确认时点", "revenue_timing"
            if "合同产生的收入的情况" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "合同产生的收入", "contract_type"
            if "商品类型" == compact:
                basis, dimension = "全部营业收入/商品类型", "product"
            if "按销售渠道分类" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "全部营业收入/销售渠道", "sales_mode"
            if "主营业务分地区列示如下" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "主营业务收入/地区", "region"
            if "按经营地区分类" in compact:
                basis, dimension = (
                    (
                        "主营业务收入/经营地区"
                        if main_only_regions
                        else "全部营业收入/经营地区"
                    ),
                    "region",
                )
            if "市场或客户类型" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "全部营业收入/市场或客户类型", "region"
            if "营业收入、营业成本的明细" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "营业收入明细", "product"
                business_basis = ""
            elif "营业收入明细" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "营业收入明细", "business_type"
            report_dim = re.fullmatch(
                r"[A-C][.．]主营业务[（(]分(行业|产品|地区)[)）]", compact
            )
            if report_dim:
                basis, dimension = (
                    "主营业务收入",
                    {"行业": "industry", "产品": "product", "地区": "region"}[
                        report_dim[1]
                    ],
                )
                business_basis = ""
            if "国家或地区" in compact:
                basis, dimension = "对外交易收入", "region"
            if "分部间抵销" in compact and "合计" in compact and "收入" not in compact:
                header = re.sub(r"分部\s*\d+\s*", "", line)
                segment_labels = re.sub(
                    r"^\s*(?:项目|合同分类|202\d\s*年)\s*", "", header
                ).split()
                # Native numbered segment headers have no repeated year row.
                if re.search(r"分部\s*\d+", line):
                    current_columns = True
                if re.match(r"202\d\s*年", header.strip()):
                    current_columns = True
            if re.search(r"[^\s]+-分部", compact) and compact.endswith("合计"):
                aggregate_income_columns = True
                conventional_years = False
            # A conventional current/prior header must be present; an isolated
            # sentence with a number is not an income row.
            if re.search(r"(?:本期|202\d年).*(?:上期|202\d年)", compact) or compact in {
                "收入成本收入成本",
                "营业收入营业成本营业收入营业成本",
                "营业收入营业成本营业收入营业成本营业收入营业成本营业收入营业成本",
            }:
                current_columns = True
                if re.search(r"本期.*上期", compact) or compact == "收入成本收入成本":
                    conventional_years = True
        match = re.match(
            r"^\s*(?P<label>.+?)\s+(?P<values>(?:\(?-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\)?|-|/)(?:\s+(?:\(?-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?\)?|-|/))*)\s*$",
            line,
        )
        if not match or not current_columns:
            continue
        label = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match["label"])
        values = match["values"].split()
        if (
            not re.search(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]", label)
            or label in {"项目", "合计", "总计"}
            and not (
                label == "合计"
                and (
                    basis in {"营业收入", "主营业务收入", "其他业务收入"}
                    or basis == "营业收入明细"
                    or basis.startswith(("全部营业收入", "主营业务收入/"))
                )
            )
            or "合计" in label
            and label != "分部营业收入合计"
            and not (
                label == "合计"
                and (
                    basis in {"营业收入", "主营业务收入", "其他业务收入"}
                    or basis == "营业收入明细"
                    or basis.startswith(("全部营业收入", "主营业务收入/"))
                )
            )
            or "年度" in label
        ):
            continue
        if title == "项目销售收入":
            # Layout may omit a blank current cell. A one-value row is accepted
            # only when its printed placement is in the current column, handled
            # below by the header/row geometry marker retained in the span.
            if label in _prior_only_income_labels(text):
                continue
            rows.append((dimension, label, values[0], basis, None))
            continue
        if title == "贸易业务收入":
            if not re.search(r"[√✓]适用\s*□不适用", text) or not values:
                continue
            rows.append((dimension, label, values[0], basis, None))
            continue
        if segment_labels and any(
            b in label
            for b in ("对外交易收入", "分部间交易收入", "分部营业收入合计", "营业收入")
        ):
            column_basis = next(
                b
                for b in (
                    "分部间交易收入",
                    "对外营业收入",
                    "对外交易收入",
                    "分部营业收入合计",
                    "营业收入",
                )
                if b in label
            )
            paired_years = len(values) == 2 * len(segment_labels)
            cells = values[::2] if paired_years else values
            labels = list(segment_labels)
            if not paired_years and column_basis in {"对外交易收入", "对外营业收入"}:
                labels = [l for l in labels if "抵销" not in l]
            elif not paired_years and column_basis == "分部间交易收入":
                # Compact parsers omit blanks. The native report's reconciliation
                # fixes missing internal cells as external == segment total.
                totals = {
                    r[1]: r[2] for r in rows if r[3] in {"营业收入", "分部营业收入合计"}
                }
                external = {
                    r[1]: r[2] for r in rows if r[3] in {"对外交易收入", "对外营业收入"}
                }
                labels = [
                    l
                    for l in labels
                    if l != "合计" and ("抵销" in l or totals.get(l) != external.get(l))
                ]
            if len(cells) != len(labels):
                continue
            for name, value in zip(labels, cells):
                if name == "未分配项目" or value == "-":
                    continue
                adjustment = (
                    RowClass.CONSOLIDATION_ADJUSTMENT if "抵销" in name else None
                )
                val = "-" + value[1:-1] if value.startswith("(") else value
                rows.append(
                    (
                        "adjustment" if adjustment else "business_segment",
                        name,
                        val,
                        column_basis,
                        adjustment,
                    )
                )
            continue
        if values[0] in {"-", "/"}:
            continue
        if label in {"合计", "小计", "其中：合同产生的收入", "其他收入"} and (
            basis in {"主营业务收入", "其他业务收入", "营业收入", "营业收入明细"}
            or basis == "营业收入明细"
            or basis.startswith(("全部营业收入", "主营业务收入/"))
        ):
            rows.append(
                (
                    (
                        dimension
                        if basis == "营业收入明细" or title == "报告分部的财务信息"
                        else "business_type"
                    ),
                    "主营业务"
                    if label == "小计" and basis == "主营业务收入"
                    else label.removeprefix("其中："),
                    values[0],
                    "营业收入"
                    if basis.startswith("全部营业收入/商品类型/")
                    else basis
                    if basis in {"营业收入明细", "营业收入"}
                    or title == "报告分部的财务信息"
                    else "营业收入/" + basis,
                    None,
                )
            )
            continue
        category = re.fullmatch(r"(?:[12][．.])?(主营业务|其他业务)", label)
        if category:
            business_basis = category[1]
            if not dimension:
                # The separate native revenue/cost header handles these totals.
                continue
            if dimension == "revenue_timing":
                # Parent total for timing children, not a geographic/sales row.
                continue
            if dimension == "product":
                basis = "全部营业收入/商品类型/" + business_basis
            rows.append(("business_type", category[1], values[0], "营业收入", None))
            continue
        if re.match(r"^(?:主营业务收入|其他业务收入)[(（]?[a-z]?[)）]?$", label):
            name = re.sub(r"[(（][a-z][)）]", "", label)
            rows.append(("business_type", name, values[0], "营业收入", None))
            continue
        if label == "固定资产试运行销售":
            rows.append(("product", label, values[0], "固定资产试运行销售收入", None))
            continue
        if basis and dimension:
            if any(t in label for t in ["成本", "说明", "报告", "日期"]) or values[
                0
            ] in {"-", "/"}:
                continue
            amount = (
                values[-2]
                if (aggregate_income_columns or segment_labels)
                and not conventional_years
                and len(values) >= 2
                else values[0]
            )
            label = label.removeprefix("其中：").rstrip("：:")
            if label.startswith("与客户间的运输合同产生的"):
                label = label.removeprefix("与客户间的运输合同产生的")
            row_basis = (
                basis + "/" + business_basis if dimension == "revenue_timing" else basis
            )
            rows.append((dimension, label, amount, row_basis, None))
    return rows


def _prior_only_income_labels(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Blank current cells must be distinguished from one-value current rows.

    Derive column positions from complete two-value rows in the original layout.
    Plain text without positions cannot locate an isolated value in either year.
    """
    numbered = []
    pairs = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        matches = list(re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", line))
        if not matches or re.search(r"合计|总计|单位", line):
            continue
        label = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[: matches[0].start()])
        numbered.append((label, matches))
        if len(matches) == 4 and re.search(r"\s{3,}", line):
            pairs.append((matches[0].start(), matches[2].start()))
        if len(matches) == 2 and re.search(r"\s{3,}", line):
            pairs.append((matches[0].start(), matches[1].start()))
    boundary = sum((a + b) / 2 for a, b in pairs) / len(pairs) if pairs else None
    return {
        label
        for label, matches in numbered
        if len(matches) == 1 and (boundary is None or matches[0].start() > boundary)
    }


def _current_sparse_income_label(text: str) -> str | None:
    """Locate one printed sparse income cell using both native year totals.

    Plain owner text can lose blank-column positions. Accept a printed value
    only if the first table's current total requires it and the prior total
    already reconciles without it; never infer a missing amount or cost.
    """
    if not re.search(r"本期发生额\s+上期发生额\s+收入\s+成本\s+收入\s+成本", text):
        return None
    complete = []
    sparse = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(主营业务|其他业务|合计)\s+(.+?)\s*", line)
        if m is None:
            continue
        cells = m[2].split()
        if not all(re.fullmatch(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", c) for c in cells):
            return None
        amounts = [Decimal(c.replace(",", "")) for c in cells]
        if m[1] == "合计":
            if len(amounts) != 4 or len(sparse) != 1 or not complete:
                return None
            label, value = sparse[0]
            if (
                value != 0
                and sum(r[0] for r in complete) + value == amounts[0]
                and sum(r[2] for r in complete) == amounts[2]
            ):
                return label
            return None
        if len(amounts) == 4:
            complete.append(amounts)
        elif len(amounts) == 1:
            sparse.append((m[1], amounts[0]))
        else:
            return None
    return None


def _complete_income_decimal_tails(cells: str, tails: str) -> str:
    """Append printed continuation digits only to visibly incomplete decimals."""
    fragments = iter(tails.split())
    return re.sub(
        r"(?<![\d.])(\d[\d,]*\.\d)(?=\s|$)", lambda m: m[1] + next(fragments, ""), cells
    )


def _sparse_revenue_pair_labels(text: str) -> set[str]:
    if not re.search(
        r"本期(?:发生额|金额)上期(?:发生额|金额)(?:项目)?收入成本收入成本",
        re.sub(r"\s+", "", text),
    ):
        return set()
    complete, sparse, totals = [], [], None
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^\s*(主营业务|其他业务|合计)\s+([^\n]+)", text):
        cells = m[2].split()
        if not all(re.fullmatch(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", c) for c in cells):
            continue
        vals = [Decimal(c.replace(",", "")) for c in cells]
        if m[1] == "合计":
            totals = vals
            break
        if len(vals) == 4:
            complete.append(vals)
        elif len(vals) == 2:
            sparse.append((m[1], vals))
    if (
        totals
        and len(totals) == 4
        and sparse
        and complete
        and all(
            sum(r[col] for r in complete) + sum(r[1][j] for r in sparse) == totals[col]
            for j, col in enumerate((0, 2))
        )
    ):
        return {r[0] for r in sparse}
    return set()


def _lessor_income_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Recover wrapped tenants/assets without moving prior-only rent left."""
    text = re.sub(r"(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})(?=\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})", r"\1 ", text)
    pieces = re.split(r"(?m)(?=^\s*承租方名称)", text)
    if len(pieces) > 2:
        return [row for piece in pieces[1:] for row in _lessor_income_rows(piece)]
    rows = []
    prior_only = _prior_only_income_labels(text)
    pending = ""
    current = None

    def flush():
        if current is None:
            return
        cp, asset, amount = current
        if amount != "-":
            rows.append(
                (
                    "lease",
                    asset,
                    amount,
                    "本公司作为出租方/本期确认的租赁收入",
                    None,
                    "承租方：" + cp,
                )
            )

    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip() or re.search(
            r"本公司作为出租方|年度报告|单位[:：]|承租方名称|租赁资产种类|本期确认|上期确认|^\s*(?:租赁|赁)?收入(?:\s+(?:租赁|赁)?收入)?\s*$|适用|^\s*\d+(?:\s*/\s*\d+)?\s*$",
            line,
        ):
            continue
        m = re.match(
            r"^(.*?)\s+(-|\d[\d,]*\.\d+|0)(?:\s+(-|\d[\d,]*\.\d+|0))?\s*$", line
        )
        if m:
            flush()
            label = pending + re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1])
            pending = ""
            cols = re.split(r"\s{2,}", m[1].strip())
            if len(cols) == 2 and (m[3] or re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]) not in prior_only):
                current = [
                    label.removesuffix(re.sub(r"\s+", "", cols[1])),
                    re.sub(r"\s+", "", cols[1]),
                    m[2],
                ]
                continue
            asset = re.search(
                r"(投资性房地产|投资性房地|固定资产|植物租摆|房屋及建筑物|房屋建筑物|房屋租赁|房屋及车辆|房屋及场地|车辆|房屋|土地使用权|场地租赁|广告经营权|机器设备)(?:、机器(?:设备)?)?$",
                label,
            )
            current = None
            if asset and (m[3] or re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]) not in prior_only):
                current = [label[: asset.start()], asset.group(), m[2]]
        elif current is not None:
            # Layout keeps continuation columns separated; append each to its
            # own cell instead of manufacturing a combined counterparty/asset.
            cols = re.split(r"\s{2,}", line.strip())
            if cols:
                fragment = re.sub(r"\s+", "", cols[0])
                if re.fullmatch(r"产(?:、固定资产)?|固定资产|机器设备", fragment):
                    current[1] += fragment
                    continue
                if (
                    re.search(
                        r"(?:公司|合作社|事务所|管理局|所属单位|所属公司)[）)]?$",
                        current[0],
                    )
                    and len(cols) == 1
                ):
                    flush()
                    current = None
                    pending = fragment
                    continue
                current[0] += fragment
            if len(cols) > 1:
                current[1] += re.sub(r"\s+", "", cols[1])
        else:
            pending += re.sub(r"\s+", "", line)
    flush()
    return rows


def _native_trust_income_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Keep the委托方 and受托方 wrapped cells of the applicable trust table."""
    if "本公司受托管理/承包情况表" not in text:
        return []
    table = text.split("本公司受托管理/承包情况表", 1)[1]
    if re.match(r"[:：]?\s*□适用\s*√不适用", table):
        return []
    table = re.split(r"关联托管/承包情况说明|本公司委托管理", table, maxsplit=1)[0]
    rows = []
    current = None
    columns = None
    for line in table.splitlines():
        m = re.match(
            r"\s*(?P<party>\S+)\s{2,}(?P<actor>\S+)\s{2,}(?P<kind>股权托管|其他资产托管)\s+[^\n]+?(?:公允定价|协议(?:价格|定价|价)|市场价)\s+(?P<value>\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|0)\s*$",
            line,
        )
        if m:
            current = [m["party"], m["actor"], m["kind"], m["value"]]
            columns = (m.start("actor"), m.start("kind"))
            rows.append(current)
        elif current and columns:
            actor_col, kind_col = columns
            party = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[:actor_col])
            actor = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[actor_col:kind_col])
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]+", party or " ") and re.fullmatch(
                r"[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]+", actor or " "
            ):
                current[0] += party
                current[1] += actor
            else:
                current = None
    return [
        (
            "service",
            kind,
            value,
            "本公司受托管理/承包/本期确认的托管收益",
            None,
            "委托方：" + party + "；受托方：" + actor,
        )
        for party, actor, kind, value in rows
    ]


def _native_simple_related_sales_columns(text: str) -> list[tuple] | None:
    """Read the original seller cells; a continuation never starts a new party."""
    if "获批的交易额" in text:
        return _native_current_purchase_rows(text)
    lines = re.sub(
        r"关联交易内\s*容", "关联交易内容", text.replace("\r", "")
    ).splitlines()
    heading = next(
        (
            i
            for i, line in enumerate(lines)
            if re.search(r"关联方\s{2,}关联交易内(?:容)?", line)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if heading is None:
        return None
    data = lines[heading + 1 :]
    end = next(
        (
            i
            for i, line in enumerate(data)
            if re.search(
                r"根据本公司|购销商品、提供和接受劳务|关联受托管理|本公司作为出租方",
                line,
            )
        ),
        len(data),
    )
    data = data[:end]
    pairs = []
    content_columns = []
    for line in data:
        amounts = list(re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line))
        if len(amounts) == 2:
            pairs.append([(m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in amounts])
        prefix = line[: amounts[0].start()] if amounts else ""
        m = re.match(r"\s*\S+\s{2,}(\S+)", prefix)
        if m:
            content_columns.append(m.start(1))
    if not content_columns:
        return None
    year_headers = list(
        re.finditer(r"本期(?:发生额|金额)|上期(?:发生额|金额)", lines[heading])
    )
    if not pairs and len(year_headers) != 2:
        return None
    # The printed year headers also locate an all-prior table; its current cells
    # remain empty rather than falling back to the first amount in each row.
    midpoint = (
        sum((a + b) / 2 for a, b in pairs) / len(pairs)
        if pairs
        else sum((m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in year_headers) / 2
    )
    content_column = sorted(content_columns)[len(content_columns) // 2]
    page_midpoints = {}
    page_start = 0
    for boundary in [i for i, line in enumerate(data) if "年度报告" in line] + [
        len(data)
    ]:
        page_pairs = []
        for line in data[page_start:boundary]:
            amounts = list(
                re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line)
            )
            if len(amounts) == 2:
                page_pairs.append(sum((m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in amounts) / 2)
        if page_pairs:
            midpoint = sum(page_pairs) / len(page_pairs)
        for i in range(page_start, boundary):
            page_midpoints[i] = midpoint
        page_start = boundary
    rows = []
    previous = None
    pending_party = ""
    for line_index, line in enumerate(data):
        midpoint = page_midpoints[line_index]
        if (
            not line.strip()
            or re.fullmatch(r"\s*\d+(?:\s*/\s*\d+)?\s*", line)
            or re.search(
                r"年度报告|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+|单位|适用|出售商品/提供劳务情况表|购销商品|本期发生额|上期发生额",
                line,
            )
        ):
            continue
        amounts = list(re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line))
        party = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[:content_column])
        content = re.sub(
            r"\s+",
            "",
            line[content_column : amounts[0].start()]
            if amounts
            else line[content_column:],
        )
        if amounts:
            prefix = line[: amounts[0].start()].strip()
            cells = re.split(r"\s{2,}", prefix)
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                party = re.sub(r"\s+", "", cells[0])
                content = re.sub(r"\s+", "", "".join(cells[1:]))
                content_column = line.find(cells[1])
            elif re.sub(r"\s+", "", prefix) == "合计":
                party = content = "合计"
            if party == "合计":
                content = "合计"
                pending_party = ""
            if not content:
                previous = None
                pending_party = ""
                continue
            party = pending_party + party
            pending_party = ""
            current = next(
                (m for m in amounts if (m.start() + m.end()) / 2 < midpoint), None
            )
            previous = [
                "product"
                if content == "销售商品"
                and (not party.endswith("公司") or party == "母公司")
                else "service",
                content,
                current.group() if current else None,
                "出售商品/提供劳务/本期发生额",
                None,
                "交易对方：" + party,
            ]
            if current and party:
                rows.append(previous)
        elif party:
            if previous is not None and re.fullmatch(
                r".{0,8}(?:公司|司|限合伙[）)]|业[（(]有限合伙[）)])", party
            ):
                previous[5] += party
            else:
                pending_party += party
        elif content and previous is not None:
            previous[1] += content
    return [tuple(row) for row in rows]


def _native_current_purchase_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple]:
    """Read current purchases separately from approved limits and prior cells."""
    text = text.split("采购商品/接受劳务情况表", 1)[-1]
    text = text.split("出售商品/提供劳务情况表", 1)[0]
    rows = []
    for section in re.split(r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$", text):
        lines = section.splitlines()
        starts = [
            m.start(1)
            for l in lines
            if re.search(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", l)
            and (m := re.match(r"\s*\S+\s{2,}(\S+)", l))
            and not re.search(r"关联方|单位|是否|度（|额度", l)
        ]
        if not starts:
            continue
        column = sorted(starts)[len(starts) // 2]
        current_edges = [
            ns[0].end()
            for line in lines
            if len(
                ns := list(re.finditer(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line))
            )
            >= 2
            and not re.search("单位|年度报告|本期发生额|上期发生额", line)
        ]
        if not current_edges:
            continue
        current_right = sorted(current_edges)[len(current_edges) // 2]
        actor = content = ""
        amount = None

        def flush(actor, content, amount):
            if (
                actor.endswith(("公司", "检验站", "研究院", "工厂", "分厂"))
                and content
                and amount
            ):
                rows.append(
                    (
                        "product",
                        content,
                        amount,
                        "采购商品/接受劳务/本期发生额",
                        None,
                        "交易对方：" + actor,
                    )
                )

        for line in lines:
            if not line.strip() or re.search(
                r"单位|关联方|关联交易|是否超过|获批|度（|额度|内容|本期发生额|上期发生额|^\s*[□√]|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*$",
                line,
            ):
                continue
            party = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[:column])
            if party and actor.endswith(("公司", "检验站", "研究院", "工厂", "分厂")):
                flush(actor, content, amount)
                actor = content = ""
                amount = None
            if party and re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]+", party):
                actor += party
            ns = list(re.finditer(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line))
            current = next((m for m in ns if abs(m.end() - current_right) <= 4), None)
            boundary = ns[0].start() if ns else current_right - 14
            fragment = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[column:boundary])
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z、]+", fragment or " "):
                content += fragment
            if current:
                amount = current.group()
        flush(actor, content, amount)
    return rows


def _native_related_sales_columns(text: str) -> list[tuple] | None:
    """Bind wrapped party and content cells to their printed two-year row."""
    if "获批的交易额" in text:
        return _native_current_purchase_rows(text)
    lines = re.sub(
        r"关联交易内\s*容", "关联交易内容", text.replace("\r", "")
    ).splitlines()
    heading = next(
        (
            i
            for i, l in enumerate(lines)
            if re.search(r"关联方\s{2,}关联交易内(?:容)?", l)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if heading is None:
        return None
    if not any(
        "、" in line[: m.start()]
        for line in lines[heading + 1 :]
        if (m := re.search(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line))
    ):
        return _native_simple_related_sales_columns(text)
    data = lines[heading + 1 :]
    end = next(
        (
            i
            for i, l in enumerate(data)
            if re.search(
                r"根据本公司|购销商品、提供和接受劳务|关联受托管理|本公司作为出租方", l
            )
        ),
        len(data),
    )
    data = data[:end]
    rows = []
    # Each repeated page header resets physical columns. Content and party
    # fragments above/below a centred amount stay with that row, not its neighbour.
    sections = re.split(r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$", "\n".join(data))
    for section in sections:
        block = section.splitlines()
        anchors = []
        content_starts = []
        pairs = []
        for i, line in enumerate(block):
            amounts = list(
                re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line)
            )
            if not amounts:
                continue
            anchors.append((i, amounts))
            if len(amounts) == 2:
                pairs.append(sum((a.start() + a.end()) / 2 for a in amounts) / 2)
            prefix = line[: amounts[0].start()]
            cells = re.match(r"\s*\S+\s{2,}(\S+)", prefix)
            if cells:
                content_starts.append(cells.start(1))
        if not anchors or not content_starts:
            continue
        if not pairs:
            # A continuation can contain only current-only and prior-only rows.
            # Preserve the inherited year header instead of dropping this page.
            rows.extend(
                _native_simple_related_sales_columns(lines[heading] + "\n" + section)
                or []
            )
            continue
        column = min(content_starts)
        midpoint = sum(pairs) / len(pairs)
        cells = [[[], []] for _ in anchors]
        for i, line in enumerate(block):
            if not line.strip() or re.search(
                r"年度报告|单位|适用|关联方|获批的交易|是否超过交易|额度|^\s*(?:[（(]如适|用[）)])\s*$|本期发生额|上期发生额|出售商品/提供劳务情况表|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*$",
                line,
            ):
                continue
            distances = [abs(a[0] - i) for a in anchors]
            nearest = [
                k for k, distance in enumerate(distances) if distance == min(distances)
            ]
            k = nearest[0]
            amounts = list(
                re.finditer(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}|(?<![\d.,])0(?![\d.,])", line)
            )
            prefix = line[: amounts[0].start()] if amounts else line
            party = re.sub(r"\s+", "", prefix[:column])
            content = re.sub(r"\s+", "", prefix[column:])
            if content.startswith(")") and party.count("(") > party.count(")"):
                party += ")"
                content = content[1:]
            if not amounts:
                before = [j for j, a in enumerate(anchors) if a[0] < i]
                after = [j for j, a in enumerate(anchors) if a[0] > i]
                if (
                    party
                    and before
                    and re.fullmatch(
                        r".{0,8}(?:公司|所属单位|所属公司)[）)]?|司", party
                    )
                ):
                    k = before[-1]
                elif (
                    party
                    and after
                    or (
                        content
                        and after
                        and re.match(r"购买|采购|销售|提供|接受", content)
                        and (
                            not before
                            or not "".join(cells[before[-1]][1]).endswith(("、", "，"))
                        )
                    )
                ):
                    k = after[0]
                elif content and len(content) < 10 and before:
                    k = before[-1]
            if len(nearest) > 1 and not party and not (content and len(content) < 10):
                next_k = nearest[-1]
                # A new party starts the next vertically centred row. A short
                # one-line previous cell has no continuation above that row.
                previous_content = "".join(cells[k][1])
                if (party and len(party) > 8) or (
                    content and len(previous_content) < 10
                ):
                    k = next_k
            cells[k][0].append(party)
            cells[k][1].append(content)
        for k, (_, amounts) in enumerate(anchors):
            party, content = ("".join(v) for v in cells[k])
            if party == "合计":
                content = "合计"
            current = next(
                (a for a in amounts if (a.start() + a.end()) / 2 < midpoint), None
            )
            if not party or not content or not current:
                continue
            rows.append(
                (
                    "product"
                    if content == "销售商品"
                    and (not party.endswith("公司") or party == "母公司")
                    else "service",
                    content,
                    current.group(),
                    "出售商品/提供劳务/本期发生额",
                    None,
                    "交易对方：" + party,
                )
            )
    return rows


def _project_native_income_span(

        "按销售模式",

        "报告分部的财务信息",

        "房地产结转收入",
        "主营业务收入补充说明",
        "贸易业务收入",
        "电量收入及成本",
        "关联服务及出租收入",
        "经营租赁收入",
        "主营业务分业务",

        "转租收入",
        "融资租赁收入",
        "关联租出资产收入",
        "非全资子公司收入",
        "在建项目收入",
        "经营正文收入",
        "合营企业收入",
        "收入确认交叉单元",
        "关联服务交易收入",
        "临时关联服务收入",
        "受托管理收入",
        "行业产品销售收入",
    }:
        return None
    si = _prepared_for(selection, span, "segment_dimension")
    mi = _prepared_for(selection, span, "operating_revenue")
    text = (
        span.excerpt
        if title
        in {
            "收入确认交叉单元",
            "联营企业收入",
            "合营企业收入",
            "主体营业收入",
            "贸易业务收入",
        }
        or "合同分类" in span.excerpt
        or "-分部" in span.excerpt
        else _join_native_income_cells(span.excerpt)
    )
    if title in {"联营企业收入", "合营企业收入"}:
        kind = title.removesuffix("收入")
        cue = "重要" + kind + "的主要财务信息"
        if cue in text:
            convention, active = text.split(cue, 1)
            active = re.split(
                r"重要(?:合营|联营)企业的主要财务信息|\n\s*[（(]\d+[)）]\.?\s*",
                active,
                maxsplit=1,
            )[0]
            if re.match(r"\s*□适用\s*√不适用", active):
                return ()
            # The report-wide financial unit may be carried before a section
            # whose own heading does not repeat it (e.g. the telecom report).
            text = convention + cue + active
    text = re.sub(
        r"((?:主营|其他)业务\s+(?:[-/]\s+){3}[-/])\s+(?=(?:主营|其他)业务)",
        r"\1\n",
        text,
    )
    text = re.sub(r"营业收\s*\n\s*入\s*\n\s*(?=\d)", "营业收入 ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"营业收\s*\n\s*入", "营业收入", text)
    text = re.sub(r"一、营业\s*\n\s*收入", "营业收入", text)
    if "合同分类" not in text and title != "主体营业收入":
        text = re.sub(r"(\.\d{2})(?=-?\d)", r"\1 ", text)
    if title == "报告分部的财务信息":
        years = list(re.finditer(r"(?m)^\s*202\d\s*年(?=[^\n]*分部间抵销)", text))
        if len(years) > 1:
            text = text[: years[1].start()]
    unit = _unit_from_excerpt(text)
    if title == "经营正文收入":
        m = re.search(r"收入(?:达到)?\s*(?:人民币)?\s*\d[\d,.]*\s*(亿元|万元)", text)
        unit = m[1] if m else None
    if title == "主营业务收入补充说明" and re.search(
        r"收入\s*和成本金额分别为\s*[\d,]+\s*万元", text
    ):
        unit = "万元"
    if title == "商标使用费收入" and re.search(
        r"商标使用费\s*\d[\d,]*\.\d+\s*万元", text
    ):
        unit = "万元"
    if not unit:
        return ()
    rows = (
        _native_industry_segment_rows(span.excerpt)
        if title == "报告分部的财务信息"
        else []
    )
    if title == "行业产品销售收入":
        compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text)
        if "产品档次" in compact and "产销率" in compact:
            for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^\s*(高档|中低档)\s+([^\n]+)", text):
                values = re.findall(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", m[2])
                if len(values) >= 6:
                    rows.append(("product", m[1], values[5], "产品情况/销售收入", None))
        elif "线上销售平台" in compact:
            for m in re.finditer(
                r"(?m)^\s*(\S+)\s+(高档|中低档)\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})", text
            ):
                rows.append(
                    (
                        "product",
                        m[2],
                        m[3],
                        "线上销售情况/本期销售收入",
                        None,
                        "交易对方：" + m[1],
                    )
                )
        elif "按不同类型披露公司主营业务构成" in compact:
            blocks = re.split(r"(按产品档次|按销售渠道|按地区分部)", text)
            for index in range(1, len(blocks), 2):
                label = blocks[index]
                dim = {
                    "按产品档次": "product",
                    "按销售渠道": "sales_mode",
                    "按地区分部": "region",
                }[label]
                basis = "主营业务构成/" + label
                for line in _join_segment_label_amounts(
                    blocks[index + 1], core_answer_repair=True
                ).splitlines():
                    m = re.match(r"\s*(.+?)\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})(?:\s|$)", line)
                    if m:
                        rows.append((dim, re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]), m[2], basis, None))
        else:
            dim = "sales_mode" if "渠道类型" in compact else "region"
            basis = (
                "销售渠道/本期销售收入"
                if dim == "sales_mode"
                else "区域情况/本期销售收入"
            )
            for m in re.finditer(
                r"(?m)^\s*([^\d\n]+?)\s+(\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})(?:\s|$)", text
            ):
                name = re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1])
                if not re.search(r"单位|适用|收入|渠道类型|区域名称|比重|%", name):
                    rows.append((dim, name, m[2], basis, None))
    if title == "临时关联服务收入":
        pending = ""
        for line in span.excerpt.replace("\r", "").splitlines():
            m = re.match(
                r"\s*(?:(?P<party>.+?)\s+)?(?:其他关联人|参股子公司)\s+"
                r"(?P<direction>提供劳务|购买商品|接受劳务)\s+(?P<name>\S+)\s+"
                r"市场定价\s+(?P<value>\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})\s+",
                line,
            )
            if m:
                if m["direction"] == "提供劳务":
                    rows.append(
                        (
                            "service",
                            m["name"],
                            m["value"],
                            "临时公告未披露关联交易/本期收入",
                            None,
                            "交易对方："
                            + pending
                            + re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["party"] or ""),
                        )
                    )
                pending = ""
            elif re.fullmatch(r"\s*[\u4e00-\u9fff（）：()]{2,30}\s*", line):
                pending += re.sub(r"\s+", "", line)
            else:
                pending = ""
    if title == "受托管理收入":
        trust_text = re.split(r"收益\s*\n", text, maxsplit=1)[-1]
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?P<party>[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()\s]+?有限公司)\s+本公司\s+"
            r"(?P<name>股权托管)\s+\d{4}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\s+"
            r"\d{4}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\s+[^\d]+?(?P<value>\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})",
            trust_text,
        ):
            rows.append(
                (
                    "service",
                    m["name"],
                    m["value"],
                    "本公司受托管理/承包/本期确认的托管收益",

                    "委托方：" + re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["party"]),

            )
    if title == "主营业务收入补充说明":
        m = re.search(
            r"投资性房地产[^。]+收入和成本金额分别为\s*([\d,]+)\s*万元",
            re.sub(r"\s+", "", text),
        )
        if m:
            unit = "万元"
            rows.append(
                ("product", "投资性房地产", m[1], "其他业务收入/投资性房地产", None)
            )
        m = re.search(
            r"(减：行业间交易抵消|行业间抵消|分部抵消|分部抵销)\s+(-?[\d,]+\.\d{2})",
            text,
        )
        if m:
            rows.append(
                (
                    "adjustment",
                    m[1],
                    m[2],

            )
        total = re.search(r"(主营业务合计|合计)\s+(-?[\d,]+\.\d{2})", text)
        if total:
            rows.append(("industry", total[1], total[2], "主营业务收入", None))
    if title == "房地产结转收入":
        rows.extend(_real_estate_settlement_rows(span.excerpt))
    if title == "收入确认交叉单元":
        header = next(
            (line for line in text.splitlines() if "收入确认时间" in line), ""
        )
        columns = list(re.finditer(r"销售商品及其他|提供劳务|其他业务收入", header))
        if len(columns) >= 2:
            centers = [(m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in columns]
            for line in text.splitlines():
                timing = re.search(r"在某一时(?:点|段内)确认", line)
                if timing:
                    for amount in re.finditer(r"\d[\d,]*\.\d{2}", line):
                        # Printed column placement retains empty cells; numbers
                        # must not be shifted to the preceding nonempty column.
                        center = (amount.start() + amount.end()) / 2
                        column = min(
                            range(len(columns)), key=lambda i: abs(centers[i] - center)
                        )
                        rows.append(
                            (
                                "revenue_timing",
                                columns[column].group(),
                                amount.group(),
                                "收入确认时间/" + timing.group(),

                            )
                        )
    if title == "关联服务交易收入":

            row = re.match(
                r"\s*(.+?收入)\s+(?:提供劳务|金融服务)\s+(?:\([^)]*\)\s*)*(\d[\d,]*)\s+[\d,]+\s*$",
                line,
            )
            if row:
                rows.append(
                    (
                        "service",
                        re.sub(r"\s+", "", row[1]),
                        row[2],
                        "重大关联交易/本期收入",
                        None,
                        "交易对方：" + party,
                    )
                )
    if title == "经营正文收入":
        compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text)
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?P<name>房地产开发销售|商品房|经济适用房|委建代建)(?:项目)?(?:结转)?(?:业务)?营业收入(?P<amount>\d[\d,.]*)万元",
            compact,
        ):

                (
                    "business_type",
                    m["name"],
                    m["amount"],
                    "经营业务/房地产结转收入",

                )
            )
        m = re.search(r"公司市政业务实现营业收入(?P<amount>\d[\d,.]*)万元", compact)
        if m:
            rows.append(
