                        "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                    }
                )
    if (
        title in {"临时关联服务收入", "关联服务及出租收入"}
        and "本集团" in text
        or title == "临时关联服务收入"
    ):
        records = [
            r.model_copy(
                update={
                    "subject_scope": SubjectScope.CONSOLIDATED_GROUP,
                    "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                }
            )
            for r in records
        ]
    if "母公司财务报表" in text or title == "受托管理收入":
        records = [
            r.model_copy(
                update={
                    "subject_scope": SubjectScope.ISSUER,
                    "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                }
            )
            for r in records
        ]
    if title == "关联服务及出租收入" and "本公司受托管理/承包情况表" in text:
        for index, record in enumerate(records):
            qualifier = record.source_native.qualifier or ""
            actor = qualifier.split("；受托方：")[-1]
            issuer = next(
                (
                    full
                    for candidate in selection.spans
                    for alias, full, _ in _native_actor_definitions(candidate.excerpt)
                    if alias in {"公司", "本公司", "上市公司"}
                ),
                "",
            )
            records[index] = record.model_copy(
                update={
                    "subject_scope": SubjectScope.ISSUER
                    if actor in {"本公司", issuer}
                    else SubjectScope.NAMED_SUBSIDIARY,
                    "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                }
            )
    if title == "境外子公司收入":
        records = [
            r.model_copy(
                update={
                    "subject_scope": SubjectScope.NAMED_SUBSIDIARY,
                    "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                }
            )
            for r in records
        ]
    return tuple(records)


def _owned_product_action_bindings(excerpt: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Keep current subsidiary product branches and transaction directions."""
    # Remove printed page furniture before joining a word across a page break.
    native_text = re.sub(
        r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$|^\s*\d+(?:\s*/\s*\d+)?\s*$", "", excerpt
    )
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", native_text)
    bindings = []

    def add(name, action, actor, verb="销售", header=None):
        bindings.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "action": action,
                "actor": actor,
                "verb": verb,
                "header": header,
                "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
            }
        )

    def current(clause):
        return not re.search(
            r"第三方|不从事|不销售|未销售|未开展|不购销|未购销|尚未|拟|计划|将销售|将推出|拟推出",
            clause,
        )

    # A current manufacturing declaration governs its own major-product matrix.
    # Industry discussion, future strategy and product-cost lists lie outside it.
    matrix = re.search(
        r"公司从事的主营业务是([^。]+?)等及以上产品配件的制造和销售。[\s\S]*?主要产品如下：[\s\S]+?(?=（二）公司经营模式|报告期内公司新增重要非主营业务|$)",
        text,
    )
    if matrix and not re.search(r"拟|计划|尚未", matrix[1]):
        names = re.split(r"、", matrix[1]) + ["配件"]
        table = matrix.group()
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?:包含|已形成\d+-\d+行、)([^。]+?)(?:等系列产品|全产品系列)", table
        ):
            names.extend(re.split(r"、(?!大马力)", m[1]))
        # Printed product-name cells may wrap across lines. Descriptive prose
        # supplies no extra action beyond the owner's declared matrix.
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*(全地形消\s*防车|消防泵|风力\s*灭火机|插秧机|收割机|ATV\s*全\s*地形车|电动\s*ATV|摩托车)\s*$",
            native_text,
        ):
            names.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]))
        representative = re.search(r"以([^。]+?)为核心代表", table)
        if representative:
            names.append(representative[1])
        for name in dict.fromkeys(names):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "制造和销售", "当前主要产品矩阵")
    actual = re.search(r"公司([^。]+?)等产品产销量同比增加所致", text)
    if actual and "产销量情况说明" in text:
        for name in actual[1].split("、"):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "产销量", "本期产销量说明")

    # Native media/service enumeration retains each noun and direction.
    for m in re.finditer(r"公司影视业务主要包括([^。]+?)等板块", text):
        for branch in m[1].split("、"):
            for suffix, actions in [
                ("制作与销售", (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS)),
                ("销售", (ActivityAction.SELLS,)),
                ("服务", (ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,)),
                ("租赁", (ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,)),
            ]:
                for part in (
                    branch.split("与")
                    if not branch.endswith("制作与销售")
                    else [branch]
                ):
                    if part.endswith(suffix) and not (
                        suffix == "销售" and part.endswith("制作与销售")
                    ):
                        name = (
                            part.removesuffix(suffix)
                            if suffix in {"制作与销售", "销售"}
                            else part
                        )
                        for action in actions:
                            add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", suffix)
    m = re.search(r"公司为各类影视节目与剧目提供包括([^。]+?)等全流程技术服务", text)
    if m:
        for name in re.split(r"、|及", m[1]):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "提供")
    m = re.search(r"公司[^。]+拓展(新媒体直播、[^。]+?)等业务", text)
    if m and not re.search(r"拟|计划|尚未", m.group()):
        for name in re.split(r"、|及", m[1]):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "拓展")
    if "公司已形成多平台协同发展的业务格局" in text:
        m = re.search(r"涵盖([^。]+?)等多个领域", text)
        if m and "媒体广告代理" in m[1]:
            add(
                "媒体广告代理",
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "代理",
            )
    m = re.search(r"公司旅游业务[^。]+主要收入来源包括([^。]+?)等", text)
    if m:
        for name in re.split(r"、|和", m[1]):
            if name.endswith("销售"):
                add(
                    name.removesuffix("销售"),
                    ActivityAction.SELLS,
                    "公司及合并子公司",
                    "销售",
                )
            else:
                add(
                    name,
                    ActivityAction.OPERATES
                    if name.endswith("经营")
                    else ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    "公司及合并子公司",
                    "经营" if name.endswith("经营") else "服务",
                )
    m = re.search(r"业务涉及([^。]+?)等多元领域", text)
    if m and "影视城" in text and "报告期内" in text:
        for name in m[1].split("、"):
            add(
                name,
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "服务",
                "当前基地业务",
            )
    if re.search(r"公司自\d{4}年起布局基金投资业务", text):
        add("基金投资", ActivityAction.OPERATES, "公司及合并子公司", "投资")
    for actor, kind, business, _ in _native_company_columns(excerpt) or []:
        if not current(business):
            continue
        entries = []
        m = re.match(r"(.+?)制造销售", business)
        if m:
            entries.extend(
                (m[1], a, "制造销售")
                for a in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS)
            )
        if business.rstrip("等") == "服务托管":
            entries.append(("服务托管", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "托管"))
        if "节目制作、技术开发服务、影视设备租赁" in business:
            entries.extend(
                (name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "服务")
                for name in business.removesuffix("等").split("、")
            )
        if "广告业务" in business and re.search(r"代理|制作", business):
            entries.append(("广告业务", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "代理"))
        for name, action, verb in entries:
            add(name, action, actor, verb, "控股参股公司原业务")
            if kind == "参股公司":
                bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([\u4e00-\u9fff]+有限公司)为本公司[^。]+全资子公司[^。]*。(?:[^。]*。){0,2}?公司经营范围：([^。]+)。",
        text,
    ):
        if m[2].rstrip("等") == "投资管理、资产管理、投资咨询":
            for name in m[2].removesuffix("等").split("、"):
                add(
                    name,
                    ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    m[1],
                    "服务",
                    "原全资子公司经营范围",
                )
    if "已签订的重大采购合同截至本报告期的履行情况" in text and "√适用□不适用" in text:
        section = re.split(
            r"已签订的重大采购合同截至本报告期的履行情况", native_text, maxsplit=1
        )[1].split("成本分析表", 1)[0]
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,8}频道整\s*频道\s*(?:电视)?\s*广告资源)",
            section,
        ):
            add(
                re.sub(r"\s+", "", m[1]),
                ActivityAction.PURCHASES,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "采购",
                "当期重大采购合同履行",
            )
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,8}频道整(?:频道)?)[^\n]*\n\s*((?:电视)?(?:频道)?广告资源)",
            section,
        ):
            add(
                m[1] + m[2],
                ActivityAction.PURCHASES,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "采购",
                "当期重大采购合同履行",
            )

    # A branch's own grammar governs its named objects, independently of
    # neighbouring branches, product illustrations, or future orders.
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"业务主要包括([^；。]+?)(?:的研发、生产和销售|等产品的生产与销售|的研发、生产与销售)",
        text,
    ):
        if current(m.group()):
            for name in m[1].split("、"):
                name = name.removeprefix("公司输变电").removesuffix("及其他输变电产品")
                if name:
                    for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                        add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "生产与销售")
    coal = re.search(
        r"业务主要包括(煤炭)的开采与销售以及(电力)及(热力)的生产和供应", text
    )
    if coal and current(coal.group()):
        for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
            add(coal[1], action, "公司及合并子公司", "开采与销售")
        for name in (coal[2], coal[3]):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE):
                add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "生产和供应")
    cycle = re.search(r"同时为[^。]+提供([^。]+?)等全周期的能源解决方案", text)
    if cycle and current(cycle.group()):
        for name in re.split(r"、|及", cycle[1]):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "提供")
    resources = re.search(
        r"资源贸易涉及([^。]+?)等冶金工业原料。主要业务模式[^。]+?采购，销售给", text
    )
    if resources and current(resources.group()):
        for name in resources[1].split("、"):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PURCHASES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "采购、销售")
    service = re.search(r"供应链服务包含([^。]+?)等，主要依托", text)
    if service and current(service.group()):
        if "提供风险管理咨询服务" in text:
            add(
                "风险管理咨询",
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "提供",
            )
        for name in service[1].split("、"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "服务")
        for names in re.findall(r"为[^。]+?提供([^。]+?)(?:等各类服务|服务)", text):
            for name in names.split("、"):
                if name in {"物流", "期货交割", "风险管理咨询"}:
                    add(
                        name,
                        ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                        "公司及合并子公司",
                        "提供",
                    )
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]+有限(?:责任)?公司)：为公司主要从事([^。]+?)(?:业务)?的子公司",
        text,
    ):
        actor, branch = m.groups()
        actor = actor.lstrip("（）()")
        if not current(branch):
            continue
        if branch.endswith("购销"):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PURCHASES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                add(branch.removesuffix("购销"), action, actor, "购销")
        elif branch == "黑色金属贸易流通":
            add("黑色金属", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "贸易流通")
        else:
            for name in re.split(r"、|以及", branch):
                if name in {"船代", "货代", "加工配送", "招标代理"}:
                    add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "服务")
    for actor, kind, business, _ in _native_company_columns(excerpt) or []:
        if kind != "子公司" or not current(business):
            continue
        goods = re.match(r"(.+?)(?:的制造、销售|的生产、销售|开采及销售)", business)
        if goods:
            for name in goods[1].split("、"):
                if "研发" in name:
                    continue
                for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                    add(name, action, actor, "生产、销售")

    # Explicit operating lists preserve direction; a risk-price list is not a purchase.
    services = re.search(r"为其提供大宗([^。]+?)等的一体化供应链服务", text)
    if services and current(services.group()):
        for name in services[1].split("、"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "提供")
    for m in re.finditer(r"本公司及控股子公司(?:向|为)[^。]+(?:。|$)", text):
        clause = m.group()
        if not current(clause):
            continue
        # Each roman-numbered transaction keeps the company's original direction.
        for part in re.split(r"[iv]+\.", clause):
            goods = re.search(r"(采购|销售)([^；。]+?)等(?:商品|原材料)", part)
            if goods:
                for name in goods[2].split("、"):
                    add(
                        name,
                        ActivityAction.PURCHASES
                        if goods[1] == "采购"
                        else ActivityAction.SELLS,
                        "公司及合并子公司",
                        goods[1],
                    )
            service = re.search(
                r"提供([\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,70}?)等(?:物)?(?:流)?服务", part
            )
            if service:
                for name in service[1].split("、"):
                    add(
                        name,
                        ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                        "公司及合并子公司",
                        "提供",
                    )
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"将其子公司([^。]+?(?:有限责任公司|有限公司))委托本公司子公司([^。]+?(?:有限责任公司|有限公司))经营管理",
        text,
    ):
        if current(m.group()):
            add(m[1], ActivityAction.OPERATES, m[2], "经营管理")
    if "主营业务为中成药的生产与销售" in text:
        representative = re.search(r"以([^。]+?)为代表的产品", text)
        if representative:
            for name in representative[1].split("、"):
                for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                    add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", "生产与销售")
    if "公司选取销售序列中具有代表性的重点品种" in text:
        for m in re.finditer(r"代表品种包括([^；。]+?)等?[；。]", text):
            for name in m[1].removesuffix("等").split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
        top = re.search(r"主要品种为([^。]+)。", text)
        if top:
            for name in top[1].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
    if "中药材在公司原材料采购中占有重要位置" in text:
        m = re.search(r"这些基地所供应的([^。]+?)等中药材", text)
        if m:
            for name in m[1].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "公司及合并子公司", "采购")
    owner = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,20}商业)下属零售药店", excerpt)
    if owner and "主要销售" in text:
        actor = owner[1]
        goods = re.search(r"主要销售([^。]+?)等。", text)
        if goods:
            for name in goods[1].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
        if "采购中西成药及饮片" in text:
            add("中西成药及饮片", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, actor, "采购")
    for actor, kind, business, _ in _native_company_columns(excerpt) or []:
        if kind != "子公司" or not current(business):
            continue
        if re.search(r"生产及销售中药产品|制造销售中药产品", business):
            names = ["中药产品"]
            covered = re.search(r"产品涵盖([^。]+?)(?:等多个领域|$)", business)
            if covered:
                names.extend(covered[1].split("、"))
            for name in names:
                for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                    add(name, action, actor, "生产及销售", "控股公司原业务")
        enumerated = re.search(r"([^、，；。]+?)开发、经营、销售(?:等)?", business)
        if enumerated:
            for action, verb in (
                (ActivityAction.OPERATES, "开发经营"),
                (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售"),
            ):
                add(enumerated[1], action, actor, verb, "控股公司原业务")
        operated = re.search(r"经营([^、，；。]+)", business)
        if operated:
            for name in operated[1].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.OPERATES, actor, "经营", "控股公司原业务")
    native_services = re.search(
        r"铁路物流、新能源物流、铝产业物流、农产品物流分别指公司子公司([^；]+?)对外提供的市场化物流服务",
        text,
    )
    if native_services:
        for name, actor in zip(
            ("铁路物流", "新能源物流", "铝产业物流", "农产品物流"),
            native_services[1].split("、"),
        ):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "对外提供")
    logistics = re.search(
        r"综合物流指公司子公司([^。]+?)对外提供的市场化物流服务，主要包括([^。]+)", text
    )
    if logistics:
        actor = logistics[1]
        for name in re.split(r"等|综合物流方面", logistics[2], maxsplit=1)[0].split(
            "、"
        ):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "对外提供")
    if "生产制造板块包括造船、选矿和油脂加工" in text:
        for name in ("选矿", "油脂加工"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROCESSES, "公司及合并子公司", "生产制造")
        owner = re.search(r"造船业务经营主体为公司子公司([^；。]+)", text)
        if owner and re.search(r"交付\d+艘", text):
            for action in (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, ActivityAction.SELLS):
                add("船舶", action, owner[1], "造船交付")

    # Ownership and present sales govern the product list in that same branch.
    # Later plans do not negate the list and do not create additional products.
    owned = list(
        re.finditer(
            r"(?P<actor>[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12}|[A-Za-z]+(?:[A-Za-z]+)?)[（(](?:公司|全资子公司)持有其[^）)]+股权[)）]",
            text,
        )
    )
    for index, owner in enumerate(owned):
        branch = text[
            owner.end() : owned[index + 1].start()
            if index + 1 < len(owned)
            else len(text)
        ]
        intro = branch.split("该公司", 1)[0]
        products = re.search(r"(?:该公司)?主要产品(?:为|有)([^。]+)。", branch)
        if not products or not re.search(r"销售", intro) or not current(intro):
            continue
        for category in re.split(r"，以及", products[1]):
            category = re.sub(r"等(?:药品|原料药及中间体)?$", "", category)
            for name in re.split(r"[、，,]", category):
                if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff（）()]{2,40}", name):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, owner["actor"])
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?P<names>[^。；，]{2,40})等重点产品销售同比翻\d+倍", text):
        if current(m.group()):
            for name in m["names"].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"销售通信产品收入指销售(?P<names>[^。]+?)等通信产品而产生的收入", text
    ):
        if current(m.group()):
            for name in m["names"].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
    platform = re.search(
        r"省级平台：以(?P<actor>[^。；，]+)为核心省级平台，负责统一采购", text
    )
    if platform and current(platform.group()) and "药品" in text:
        add("药品", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, platform["actor"], "采购")
    table = re.split(r"营业利润\s*净利润", excerpt, maxsplit=1)
    if len(table) == 2 and _native_company_columns(excerpt) is None:
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*(?P<actor>[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z]+(?: [A-Za-z]+)?)\s+子公司\s+(?P<body>[^\d]+?)(?=\d[\d,]*\.\d{2})",
            table[1].split("报告期内取得和处置", 1)[0],
        ):
            body = re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["body"])
            sale = re.search(r"(?P<names>.+?)(?:的研发、生产与销售|的销售)", body)
            if sale and current(body):
                for name in re.split(r"[、，]|及", sale["names"]):
                    name = (
                        name.split("的研发", 1)[0].removesuffix("的").removesuffix("等")
                    )
                    if name:
                        add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, m["actor"])

    # Each subsection declares its own operator; a brand is never the object.
    for branch in re.split(r"[（(][一二三四五六][)）]", text):
        owner = re.search(
            r"业务主要由子公司(.+?有限公司(?:和[^。]+?有限公司)?)从事", branch
        )
        if not owner or not current(branch):
            continue
        actor = owner[1].replace("有限公司和", "有限公司/")
        if re.search(r"直接向[^。]+销售生猪", branch):
            add("生猪", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
        if "外购仔猪" in branch:
            add("仔猪", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, actor, "外购")
        products = re.search(
            r"产品(?:主要)?为[“\"][^”\"]+[”\"](?:和[“\"][^”\"]+[”\"])?品牌的([^。]+)",
            branch,
        )
        if products and re.search(r"销售|流通渠道|出口", branch):
            cell = re.split(r"以及相关产品", products[1], maxsplit=1)[0].removeprefix(
                "各类分切"
            )
            for name in re.split(r"、|及", cell):
                if name:
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
        # Brand products are named goods; the marketing model affirms delivery.
        products = re.search(r"产品主要有([^。]+?)等。", branch)
        if products and re.search(r"营销业务模式|销售", branch):
            for name in re.split(r"、", products[1]):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)

    for m in re.finditer(
        r"子公司([^。]+?)从事[^。]+的生产和销售，产品为[“\"][^”\"]+[”\"]品牌的([^。]+)。",
        text,
    ):
        if not current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            continue
        actor = m[1].replace("有限公司和", "有限公司/")
        # “蔬菜及番茄沙司类罐头” is one printed product, not two fragments.
        for name in re.split(r"、|和(?=蔬菜)", m[2]):
            add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"子公司([^。]+?)从事[^。]+的生产和销售，产品包括([^。]+)。", text
    ):
        if not current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            continue
        actor = (
            m[1].replace("有限公司、", "有限公司/").replace("有限公司和", "有限公司/")
        )
        cell = re.search(r"各类([^，]+)产品", m[2])
        if cell:
            for name in cell[1].split("、"):
                add(name + "产品", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([^。]+?)食品以牛排及肉牛产品为主导，集加工、销售、服务于一体[^。]+。", text
    ):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            actor = re.split(r"[；，]", m[1])[-1] + "食品"
            add("牛排", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"(?:^|[。；])([^。；]{2,12}食品)[^。]+开发([^。]+?)产品开拓餐饮新市场", text
    ):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            for name in re.split(r"及|和|、", m[2]):
                add(name + "产品", ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
    # Current performance paragraphs provide sales evidence independently of
    # a product's mere development or an IP/brand list.
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([^。，]{2,12})推出新品([^。]+?)，\d+款新品，\d{4}年新品[^。]+销售额[^。]+。",
        text,
    ):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            for name in m[2].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([^。]{2,12}食品)以[“\"]([^”\"]+)[”\"]为核心[^。]+推出了([^。]+?)等衍生产品，成为明星单品。",
        text,
    ):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            add(m[2], ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
            for name in m[3].split("、"):
                if name.endswith(("肉", "肉馅")):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([^。]{2,12})推出[“\"][^”\"]+[”\"]系列([^。]+?)等\d+款新产品。重点采用全渠道营销",
        text,
    ):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            for name in m[2].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
    for m in re.finditer(r"完成[^。]+产品的研发及上市，包括([^。]+)。", text):
        if current(_sentence_containing(text, m.start())):
            actor_match = re.search(r"(?:^|。)([^。]{2,12})多措并举", text[: m.start()])
            if not actor_match:
                continue
            cell = re.split(r"，以及", m[1], maxsplit=1)
            for name in cell[0].split("、"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor_match[1])
            if len(cell) > 1 and cell[1].endswith("棒棒糖"):
                add("棒棒糖", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor_match[1])
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,15}肉品)不断优化[\s\S]+?(?=上海爱森|$)", text
    ):
        if current(m.group()) and "持续热销" in m.group():
            goods = re.search(r"[；，]([^；，]+?)入驻[^。；，]+后持续热销", m.group())
            if goods:
                for name in goods[1].split("、"):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1])
    for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=。)", text):
        if not current(sentence):
            continue
        if "白条肉三维销售模式" in sentence and "年度白条销售超额完成" in sentence:
            add("白条肉", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
        if "猪副产品收入表现良好" in sentence:
            add("猪副产品", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
        if re.search(r"公司饲料贸易业务板块业务规模下降", sentence):
            add("饲料", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
        if re.search(r"采购端通过饲料集采", sentence):
            add("饲料", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "公司及合并子公司", "采购")
        if "生猪采购" in sentence and "公司" in sentence:
            add("生猪", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "公司及合并子公司", "采购")
        if "本公司从事油品销售收入" in sentence:
            add("油品", ActivityAction.SELLS, "本公司")
        if re.search(r"本公司与客户之间的销售合同通常包含转让", sentence):
            m = re.search(r"转让相关(.+?)，销售(.+?)及安装的履约义务", sentence)
            if m:
                for name in [*m[1].split("及"), m[2]]:
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, "本公司")
    if re.search(r"公司主要产品包括[^。]+饮用水等，主要品牌包括", text):
        clause = re.search(r"公司主要产品包括[^。]+", text)[0]
        if current(clause):
            add("饮用水", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司")
    # The native category establishes direction; a customer's 采购项目 does not.
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"(?<!不)(?<!未)(?<!拟)销售商品(.+?)(?=销售商品|购买商品|接受劳务|提供劳务|金额合计|$)",
        text,
    ):
        row = m[1]
        if not current(row):
            continue
        for product in re.finditer(
            r"车道自助发卡机|车道[^。]{0,90}?自助缴费机|高速公路机电系统设备", row
        ):
            add(
                "车道自助缴费机" if "缴费机" in product[0] else product[0],
                ActivityAction.SELLS,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                header="销售商品",
            )
    if (
        "向关联方采购商品" in text
        and not re.search(r"(?:不|未|拟|计划|将)采购商品", text)
        and re.search(r"设备及安全设施采购\d[\d,]*\.\d+\d", text)
    ):
        add(
            "设备及安全设施",
            ActivityAction.PURCHASES,
            "公司及合并子公司",
            "采购",
            "实际执行金额",
        )
    # Native subsidiary rows retain their own actor and action. Numeric columns
    # and application fields do not contribute product names.
    if "主要控股参股公司分析" in text:
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*(?P<actor>[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12})\s+子公司\s+(?P<body>[^\d。]{1,120})(?=\d)",
            excerpt,
        ):
            actor, body = m["actor"], re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["body"])
            if not current(body):
                continue
            goods = re.search(
                r"(?P<names>日用化工产品[（(]磷酸盐系列[)）])的制造、加工、销售", body
            )
            if goods:
                add(goods["names"], ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
            if "水力发电、售电" in body:
                add("电力", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "售电")
            sale = re.search(r"(?P<names>磷化工、磷酸盐产品、洗涤用品)生产销售", body)
            if sale:
                for name in sale["names"].split("、"):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
    if "企业集团的构成" in text and "业务性质" in text:
        table = re.split(
            r"在子公司的持股比例不同于表决权比例|重要的非全资子公司",
            excerpt,
            maxsplit=1,
        )[0]
        table = re.sub(r"(有限(?:责任)?)\s*\n\s*(公司)", r"\1\2", table)
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"(?m)^\s*(?P<actor>[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,45}有限(?:责任)?公司)\s+(?P<location>[^\s]+)\s+[\d,.]+\s+[^\s]+\s+(?P<body>[\s\S]+?)(?=\s+\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s)",
            table,
        ):
            actor, body = m["actor"], re.sub(r"\s+", "", m["body"])
            if not current(body) or "（注" in actor:
                continue
            trade = re.search(
                r"(?:主要从事)?(?P<names>[\u4e00-\u9fff、及]{2,40})购销", body
            )
            sale = re.search(
                r"(?:主要从事)?(?P<names>[\u4e00-\u9fff、]{2,40})(?:开采、精选和|加工及|的生产与)销售",
                body,
            )
            if trade:
                for name in re.split(r"、|及", trade["names"].removeprefix("主要从事")):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "购销")
                    add(name, ActivityAction.PURCHASES, actor, "购销")
            elif sale:
                for name in sale["names"].removeprefix("主要从事").split("、"):
                    add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor)
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"子公司(?P<actor>[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12})[：:](?P<body>[^。]+)。", text
    ):
        sale = re.search(r"[，,](?P<name>[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12})销售量价齐升", m["body"])
        if sale and current(m["body"]):
            add(sale["name"], ActivityAction.SELLS, m["actor"])
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"目前公司的[^。]+主要有[^。]*?(?P<name>磷酸氢钙)[^。]+。[^。]+产品主要供应[^。]+。",
        text,
    ):
        if current(m.group()):
            add(m["name"], ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司", "供应")
    return bindings


def _owned_goods_bindings(excerpt: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Named current goods from direct actions or owned transaction columns."""
    # Remove printed page furniture before joining a word across a page break.
    native_text = re.sub(
        r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$|^\s*\d+(?:\s*/\s*\d+)?\s*$", "", excerpt
    )
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", native_text)
    bindings = []

    def add(name, action, actor, verb):
        bindings.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "action": action,
                "actor": actor,
                "verb": verb,
                "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
            }
        )

    for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=。)", text):
        if re.search(r"尚未|第三方|不从事|未销售|拟|计划|将销售|预研", sentence):
            continue
        owned = re.search(
            r"风电主机装备业务及关键配套业务主要包括([^。]+)主机销售等。公司通过招投标的方式获取主机订单",
            text,
        )
        if (
            owned
            and "公司通过招投标的方式获取主机订单" in sentence
            and not re.search(r"不|未|拟|计划|将|第三方", owned[1])
        ):
            add("风电主机", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司", "销售")
        if re.search(r"公司(?:的)?塔筒业务主要包括[^。]+销售业务", sentence):
            add("塔筒", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司", "销售")
        if re.search(r"公司风机配件销售时", sentence):
            add("风机配件", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司", "销售")
        if re.search(r"本公司电力产品销售于[^。]+省电网公司", sentence):
            add("电力", ActivityAction.SELLS, "本公司", "销售")
        if re.search(
            r"公司控股子公司([^。]+?)主要从事叶片的设计、研发及制造业务", sentence
        ):
            actor = re.search(r"公司控股子公司([^。]+?)主要从事", sentence)[1]
            add("叶片", ActivityAction.PRODUCES, actor, "制造")
        if re.search(
            r"通过向[^。]+供应商采购[^。]+的风机零部件", sentence
        ) and re.search(r"由公司[^。]+生产制造", sentence):
            add("风机零部件", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "公司", "采购")
    if "出售商品/提供劳务情况表" in text:
        table = text.split("出售商品/提供劳务情况表", 1)[1].split(
            "购销商品、提供和接受劳务", 1
        )[0]
        if re.search(r"√适用□不适用", table) and re.search(
            r"废旧物资处置\d[\d,]*\.\d+", table
        ):
            add("废旧物资", ActivityAction.SELLS, "本公司", "出售")
    if re.search(
        r"报告期内，公司累计获取电站建设指标[^。]+完成电站项目转让规模", text
    ) and not re.search(r"(?:拟|计划|未)完成电站项目转让", text):
        add("电站产品", ActivityAction.SELLS, "本公司", "销售")

    # The affirmative owned trade row itself supplies the names. Its income
    # stays in the revenue evidence, never in a physical-quantity field.
    if "报告期内公司存在贸易业务收入" in text:
        table = text.split("报告期内公司存在贸易业务收入", 1)[1].split("贸易业务占", 1)[
            0
        ]
        row = re.search(r"主要是开展各类([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,30})等贸易业务\d", table)
        if row and not re.search(
            r"第三方|子公司|不存在|拟|计划|尚未|未开展", table[: row.end()]
        ):
            for name in re.split(r"及|、", row[1]):
                add(
                    name,
                    ActivityAction.SELLS,
                    "本集团" if "本集团" in text else "公司",
                    "销售",
                )

    for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=。)", text):
        if re.search(
            r"尚未|第三方公司|(?:不|未|拟|计划|将)(?:从事|开展|采购|销售|出售|购买|消耗)",
            sentence,
        ):
            continue
        direct = re.search(
            r"(?<!第三方)(?:本公司|公司)采购([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12})生产加工成", sentence
        )
        if direct and not re.search(r"子公司|第三方|供应商", sentence[: direct.end()]):
            add(direct[1], ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "公司", "采购")
        sale = re.search(
            r"报告期内，公司累计实现([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12})销售量达\d", sentence
        )
        if sale:
            add(sale[1], ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司", "销售")
        energy = re.search(
            r"本集团已采用[^。]+降低([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,8})消耗量", sentence
        )
        if energy:
            bindings.append(
                {
                    "name": energy[1],
                    "action": None,
                    "actor": "本集团",
                    "verb": "消耗",
                    "header": "能源",
                }
            )
        purchase = re.search(
            r"本集团大部分的([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,8})消耗须以[^。]+在国内购买", sentence
        )
        if purchase:
            add(purchase[1], ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本集团", "购买")
        received = re.search(r"向本集团(?:出售|销售)([^。]+?)而向其支付", sentence)
        if received:
            name = re.split(r"所需的", received[1])[-1]
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12}", name):
                add(name, ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本集团", "采购")
        offered = re.search(
            r"本集团向[^。]+?(?:销售|出售)([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,12}?)(?:取得的?收入|的收入|取得的?费用|，|。)",
            sentence,
        )
        if offered and not re.search(r"商品|服务|价格|收入|费用|代理", offered[1]):
            add(offered[1], ActivityAction.SELLS, "本集团", "销售")
        content_purchase = re.search(
            r"(?:^|[、，和])([^、，和]{2,12}产品)采购费是指[^。]+向本集团", sentence
        )
        if content_purchase:
            add(content_purchase[1], ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本集团", "采购")

    # Ownership comes from the table section; counterparty names never identify
    # goods. The group direction is distinct from its ultimate parent's name.
    for match in re.finditer(
        r"(?:采购商品/接受劳务情况表|出售商品/提供劳务情况表)[\s\S]+?(?=购销商品、提供和接受劳务的关联交易说明|$)",
        excerpt,
    ):
        block = match.group()
        if not re.search(r"[√✓]适用\s*□不适用", block):
            continue
        for row in re.finditer(
            r"(?:^|\n|\s)(购买|购|售)([\u4e00-\u9fff]{1,12})\s+\d[\d,]*\.\d+", block
        ):
            verb, name = row[1], row[2]
            if name.endswith("服务"):
                continue
            add(
                name,
                ActivityAction.SELLS if verb == "售" else ActivityAction.PURCHASES,
                "公司",
                verb,
            )
    if "采购商品/接受劳务" in text and re.search(r"本集团关联方关联交易", text):
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"采购商品(?:及接受劳务)?(航空配餐|航材)(?:采购)?费[^。]*?\d", text
        ):
            add(m[1], ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本集团", "采购")
        if "文创产品采购费" in text:
            add("文创产品", ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本集团", "采购")
    if "出售商品/提供劳务" in text and re.search(r"本集团关联方关联交易", text):
        table = text.split("本公司除子公司外", 1)[0]
        for m in re.finditer(r"销售商品(航空配餐)(?:[（(][a-z]+[)）])?\d", table):
            add(m[1], ActivityAction.SELLS, "本集团", "销售")
    return bindings


def _native_equity_business_rows(excerpt: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, bool]]:
    """Bind vertically wrapped entity names to their own business-nature cell."""
    lines = excerpt.splitlines()
    header = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if "业务性质" in line), None)
    if header is None:
        return []
    business_col = lines[header].index("业务性质")
    register = re.search(r"注册地", lines[header])
    if register:
        business_col = int((register.end() + business_col) / 2)
    name_col = next(
        (
            m.start()
            for line in lines[max(0, header - 1) : header + 1]
            if (m := re.search(r"主要经(?:营)?", line))
        ),
        None,
    )
    if name_col is None:
        return []
    for line in lines[header + 1 :]:
        m = re.match(r"\s*\S+\s{2,}(\S+)", line)
        if (
            m
            and re.search(r"[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z]", line[: m.start(1)])
            and m.start(1) <= name_col
        ):
            name_col = m.start(1)
            break
    associate = "权益法" in excerpt and "合营企业或联营" in excerpt
    rows = []
    actor, business = "", ""
    business_end = lines[header].find("持股比例")
    for line in lines[header + 1 :]:
        if re.search(
            r"在子公司的持股比例|在合营企业或联营企业的持股比例|[（(]2[)）]", line
        ):
            break
        if re.search(r"年度报告|^\s*\d+\s*/\s*\d+|^\s*名称|^\s*会计处理", line):
            continue
        name = re.sub(r"\s+", "", line[:name_col])
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fffA-Za-z•·（）()]+", name) or name in {
            "名称",
            "方式",
            "直接",
            "间接",
        }:
            name = ""
        if name:
            if actor.endswith(("公司", "合伙）", "合伙)")):
                rows.append((actor, business, associate))
                actor, business = "", ""
            actor += name
        cell_matches = list(
            re.finditer(
                r"(?P<cell>[^\s\d]+)\s{2,}(?P<ratio>\d{1,3}\.\d{2})(?!\d)", line
            )
        )
        cell_match = cell_matches[-1] if cell_matches else None
        if cell_match:
            business_col, business_end = (
                cell_match.start("cell"),
                cell_match.start("ratio"),
            )
        cell = line[
            business_col : business_end if business_end > business_col else None
        ]
        cell = re.split(r"\d", cell, maxsplit=1)[0]
        if actor:
            business += re.sub(r"\s+", "", cell)
    if actor:
        rows.append((actor, business, associate))
    return rows


def _native_product_matrix_bindings(excerpt: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Bind native products to their explicitly grouped parent/subsidiary cell."""
    if "公司名称" in excerpt or not re.search(
        r"母子公司\s+产品名称\s+产品说明", excerpt
    ):
        return []
    lines = excerpt.splitlines()
    header = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if "母子公司" in l and "产品名称" in l)
    rows = []
    scope = None
    description = r"保留|获得|用于|广泛|清凉|消炎|滋补|为数据|森林|产品包装|制作"
    for index in range(header + 1, len(lines)):
        line = lines[index].strip()
        if "主要经营模式" in line:
            break
        if re.search(r"母公司|子公司", line):
            scope = "issuer" if "母公司" in line else "consolidated_group"
            line = re.split(r"母公司|子公司", line, maxsplit=1)[1].strip()
        if not line or scope is None:
            continue
        m = re.match(
            r"(?P<name>[\u4e00-\u9fff、（）()]{1,20})\s+(?:" + description + ")", line
        )
        if m:
            name = m["name"]
        elif re.fullmatch(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]{1,15}", line):
            following = "".join(l.strip() for l in lines[index + 1 : index + 3])
            if not re.match(
                r"(?:[（(][^）)]+[)）])?(?:" + description + ")", following
            ):
                continue
            name = line
        elif line.startswith(("（", "(")) and rows:
            rows[-1][0] += line
            continue
        else:
            continue
        rows.append([name, scope])
    bindings = []
    for name, scope in rows:
        for native_name in (
            name.split("、") if not re.search(r"[（(]", name) else [name]
        ):
            if not native_name:
                continue
            for action, verb in [
                (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "生产"),
                (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售"),
            ]:
                bindings.append(
                    {
                        "name": native_name,
                        "action": action,
                        "verb": verb,
                        "actor": "本公司" if scope == "issuer" else "公司及合并子公司",
                        "subject_scope": SubjectScope(scope),
                        "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
                        "header": "原母子公司产品矩阵/产销",
                        "qualifier": "母公司"
                        if scope == "issuer"
                        else "公司子公司产品",
                    }
                )
    return bindings


def _native_branch_action_bindings(excerpt: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Current actions stay with the native subsidiary or marketed product list."""
    # Remove printed page furniture before joining a word across a page break.
    native_text = re.sub(
        r"(?m)^.*年度报告[^\n]*$|^\s*\d+(?:\s*/\s*\d+)?\s*$", "", excerpt
    )
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", "", native_text)
    bindings = _native_product_matrix_bindings(excerpt)

    def add(name, action, actor, verb, header=None):
        bindings.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "action": action,
                "actor": actor,
                "verb": verb,
                "header": header,
                "subject_basis": SubjectBasis.DIRECT_SOURCE_WORDING,
            }
        )

    if re.search(r"公司主要从事[^。]+产销及贸易经营", text):
        m = re.search(r"主要产品为([^。]+?)等产品[，,]", text)
        if m:
            cell = re.sub(r'[“"]([^”"]+)[”"]系列', "", m[1])
            for name in cell.split("、"):
                for action, verb in [
                    (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "产销/生产"),
                    (ActivityAction.SELLS, "产销/销售"),
                ]:
                    add(name, action, "公司及合并子公司", verb, "本期主要产品/产销")
    note = re.search(
        r"注\d+：([^。]+?)成立于\d{4}年，是一家从事([^。]+?)的高新技术企业", text
    )
    if note and re.search(
        r"截至报告日[^。]+" + re.escape(note[1]) + r"[^。]+参股项目[^。]+未纳入合并",
        text,
    ):
        actor = note[1]
        association = "报告披露日参股企业业务，未纳入合并，不视为集团本期经营"
        add(note[2], ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "从事", "参股企业原业务")
        if "提供SaaS服务" in text:
            add(
                "SaaS服务",
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                actor,
                "提供",
                "参股企业原业务",
            )
        chips = re.search(r"自主研发([^。]+?)芯片", text)
        if chips:
            for name in chips[1].split("与"):
                add(
                    name + "芯片",
                    ActivityAction.DEVELOPS,
                    actor,
                    "自主研发",
                    "参股企业原研发",
                )
        for binding in bindings:
            if binding.get("actor") == actor:
                binding.update(
                    subject_scope=SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT, qualifier=association
                )
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"([^。：；，]+?)深化自有品牌[^。]+加强([^。]+?)等优势产品研发生产", text
    ):
        actor = m[1].split("电子通讯产业")[-1]
        for name in m[2].split("、"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PRODUCES, actor, "研发生产", "本期具名子公司产品")
    for m in re.finditer(
        r"报告期，([^。]+?)的营业收入[^。]+(?:光模块产品销售同比增加)", text
    ):
        add("光模块", ActivityAction.SELLS, m[1], "产品销售", "本期具名子公司销售")
    if "国内木竹片采购定价主要采取挂牌采购" in text:
        for name in ("木片", "竹片"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "本公司", "挂牌采购", "母公司原料采购")
            bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.ISSUER
    m = re.search(r"大宗([^。]+?)等主要采用公开招标", text)
    if m:
        for name in m[1].split("、"):
            add(
                "大宗" + name if name == "原材料" else name,
                ActivityAction.PURCHASES,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "公开招标采购",
            )
    m = re.search(
        r"本公司主营业务包含开展([^。]+?)等，通过下属全资子公司([^。]+?)开展上述业务",
        text,
    )
    if m:
        for name in m[1].split("、"):
            add(
                name.removeprefix("提供").removesuffix("业务"),
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                m[2],
                "开展",
                "日常经营投资；非营业收入",
            )
    m = re.search(
        r"公司控股子公司([^。]+?)基于算力业务[^。]+?采购先进计算技术服务，包括但不限于([^。]+?)，",
        text,
    )
    if m:
        for name in ["算力服务", "存储服务"]:
            if name.removesuffix("服务") in m[2]:
                add(name, ActivityAction.PURCHASES, m[1], "采购", "先进计算技术服务")
    if "本公司向客户销售房地产" in text:
        add("房地产", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司", "销售")
    for m in re.finditer(r"本公司向客户提供([^。]+?)，该服务", text):
        for name in m[1].split("、"):
            add(
                "物业服务" if name == "物业管理服务" else name,
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "提供",
            )
    for row in _real_estate_settlement_rows(excerpt):
        if (
            row[3] == "房地产销售和结转/结转收入金额"
            and Decimal(row[2].replace(",", "")) > 0
        ):
            add(row[1], ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司", "本期结转", row[3])
            associated = re.search(r"不含联营([^、，）)]+?)项目", text)
            if associated and associated[1] in row[1]:
                bindings[-1].update(
                    actor=associated[1] + "联营项目",
                    subject_scope=SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT,
                    qualifier="联营项目，不含在集团结转合计内",
                )
    if "经营业态" in excerpt and "出租房地产的租" in text:
        for row in _real_estate_settlement_rows(excerpt):
            if row[3] != "房地产出租/租金收入":
                continue
            add(
                row[1],
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                "公司及合并子公司",
                "出租",
                "房地产出租/经营业态",
            )
            bindings[-1]["qualifier"] = row[5]

    def current(clause):
        return not re.search(
            r"第三方|拟|计划|不销售|未销售|不采购|未采购|尚未|未开展|未常态化|不常态化|将销售",
            clause,
        )

    def business_actions(actor, business, header):
        if not current(business):
            return
        if business.startswith("房地产开发"):
            add("房地产开发", ActivityAction.OPERATES, actor, "开发", header)
        if business.startswith("商品销售业务"):
            add("商品销售业务", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "销售", header)
        if business.startswith("物业服务"):
            add("物业服务", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "服务", header)
        if business.startswith("远洋捕捞"):
            add("远洋捕捞", ActivityAction.OPERATES, actor, "捕捞", header)
            if "食品加工" in business:
                add("食品加工业", ActivityAction.OPERATES, actor, "食品加工", header)
        if business.startswith("交易鱼类和鱼产品"):
            for name in ("鱼类", "鱼产品"):
                add(name, ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "交易", header)
        if business.startswith("水产品加工及销售"):
            add("水产品", ActivityAction.PROCESSES, actor, "加工", header)
            add("水产品", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "销售", header)
        if business.startswith("罐头食品加工"):
            add("罐头食品", ActivityAction.PROCESSES, actor, "加工", header)
        if business.startswith("海上运输"):
            add("海上运输", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "运输", header)
        if business.startswith("收购、加工销售鱼产品"):
            for action, verb in (
                (ActivityAction.PURCHASES, "收购"),
                (ActivityAction.PROCESSES, "加工"),
                (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售"),
            ):
                add("鱼产品", action, actor, verb, header)
        if business.startswith("渔货贸易"):
            add("渔货", ActivityAction.SELLS, actor, "贸易", header)

    for actor, business, associate in _native_equity_business_rows(excerpt):
        if not associate:
            business_actions(actor, business, "原子公司业务性质")
        for m in re.finditer(r"(药品|外用溶液剂)生产销售", business):
            for action, verb in [
                (ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "生产"),
                (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售"),
            ]:
                add(m[1], action, actor, verb, "原子公司业务性质")
        if "技术服务、开发、转让" in business:
            add(
                "技术服务",
                ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                actor,
                "技术服务",
                "原子公司业务性质",
            )
        if associate and "生产显示器及LCD电视机" in business:
            for name in ["显示器", "LCD电视机"]:
                add(
                    name, ActivityAction.PRODUCES, actor, "生产", "原权益法主体业务性质"
                )
                bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT
        if associate and "基金募集、基金销售、特定客户资产管理" in business:
            for name in ["基金募集", "基金销售", "特定客户资产管理"]:
                add(
                    name,
                    ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    actor,
                    "原业务服务",
                    "原权益法主体业务性质",
                )
                bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT

    # Enumerated native verbs share their noun. Business labels, raw-material
    # explanations and research clauses are not products with those verb names.
    for actor, kind, business, _ in _native_company_columns(excerpt) or []:
        if kind == "子公司":
            business_actions(actor, business, "控股参股公司原业务")
        if not current(business):
            continue
        if kind == "子公司" and "母子公司" in excerpt and "产销及贸易经营" in text:
            matrix = re.split(
                r"\d+、公司的主要经营模式", excerpt.split("母子公司", 1)[1], maxsplit=1
            )[0]
            for name in re.split(r"、|和", business):
                if (
                    name
                    and (
                        name
                        in {
                            b["name"]
                            for b in _native_product_matrix_bindings(
                                "公司及子公司主要产品及用途如下：\n"
                                + "母子公司"
                                + matrix
                            )
                        }
                        or "药业" in actor
                        and "医药行业" in matrix
                    )
                    and not re.search(r"原料|贸易|研发|服务|维修|制造", name)
                ):
                    add(
                        name,
                        ActivityAction.PRODUCES,
                        actor,
                        "本期产销/生产",
                        "原产品矩阵与子公司业务",
                    )
        if kind == "子公司":
            if "机械维修、制造" in business:
                add(
                    "机械维修",
                    ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    actor,
                    "维修",
                    "原子公司业务",
                )
                add("机械", ActivityAction.PRODUCES, actor, "制造", "原子公司业务")
            if "污水处理服务" in business:
                add(
                    "污水处理服务",
                    ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    actor,
                    "污水处理",
                    "原子公司业务",
                )
            if "森林培育" in business:
                add(
                    "森林培育",
                    ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE,
                    actor,
                    "培育",
                    "原子公司业务",
                )
            timber = re.search(r"(木竹|竹材)采运", business)
            if timber:
                add(timber[1], ActivityAction.PRODUCES, actor, "采运", "原子公司业务")
                bindings[-1]["qualifier"] = (
                    "原主体：" + actor + "；原文采运，不反推本期销售"
                )
        rules = (
            (
                r"^(.+?)采选、销售",
                [(ActivityAction.PROCESSES, "采选"), (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售")],
            ),
            (
                r"^生产、销售([^，；]+)",
                [(ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "生产"), (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售")],
            ),
            (
                r"^生产、经营([^，；]+)",
                [(ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "生产"), (ActivityAction.OPERATES, "经营")],
            ),
            (
                r"^(.+?)生产销售",
                [(ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "生产"), (ActivityAction.SELLS, "销售")],
            ),
        )
        for pattern, actions in rules:
            m = re.search(pattern, business)
            if not m:
                continue
            for name in re.split(r"、|和|及", re.sub(r"等(?:产品)?$", "", m[1])):
                for action, verb in actions:
                    add(name, action, actor, verb, "控股参股公司原业务")
                    if kind == "参股公司":
                        bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.BUSINESS_SEGMENT

    # Current park services and fishing operations are stated independently
    # from general industry descriptions and future development plans.
    if "工业园区运营" in text and "核心主业" in text and "产业投资方面，公司" in text:
        add("工业园区", ActivityAction.OPERATES, "公司及合并子公司", "运营")
        add("产业投资", ActivityAction.OPERATES, "公司及合并子公司", "产业投资")
    m = re.search(r"旗下([^。]+?孵化器)为在孵企业提供([^。]+?)等专业化服务", text)
    if m and current(
        text[
            max(text.rfind("。", 0, m.start()), text.rfind("；", 0, m.start()))
            + 1 : m.end()
        ]
    ):
        for name in m[2].split("、"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, m[1], "提供服务")
            bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.NAMED_SUBSIDIARY
    m = re.search(r"常态化开展([^。]+?)等服务", text)
    if m and current(
        text[
            max(text.rfind("。", 0, m.start()), text.rfind("；", 0, m.start()))
            + 1 : m.end()
        ]
    ):
        for name in m[1].split("、"):
            add(name, ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "开展服务")
    m = re.search(r"为在孵企业提供政策咨询服务[^。]+提升([^。]+?)服务水平", text)
    if m and current(
        text[
            max(text.rfind("。", 0, m.start()), text.rfind("；", 0, m.start()))
            + 1 : m.end()
        ]
    ):
        actor = re.sub(r"国家级", "", m[1])
        add("政策咨询", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, actor, "提供政策咨询")
        bindings[-1]["subject_scope"] = SubjectScope.NAMED_SUBSIDIARY
    if "房产销售成交量增长，房产销售收入增加" in text:
        add("房产", ActivityAction.SELLS, "公司及合并子公司", "房产销售")
    if (
        "公司房产租赁规模有所增加" in text
        or "房产租赁收入增加" in text
        or "房产租赁收入有所增加" in text
        or "公司房产租赁业务增加" in text
    ):
        add("房产租赁", ActivityAction.PROVIDES_SERVICE, "公司及合并子公司", "租赁")
    m = re.search(r"公司金枪鱼围网船队[^。]+开展生产作业，产品以([^，。]+?)为主", text)
    if m and current(
        text[
            max(text.rfind("。", 0, m.start()), text.rfind("；", 0, m.start()))
            + 1 : m.end()
        ]
    ):
        for name in ["金枪鱼", *m[1].split("、")]:
            add(name, ActivityAction.PRODUCES, "公司及合并子公司", "捕捞生产")
    m = re.search(r"与([^；。]+?有限公司)开展合作经营，在[^；。]+捕捞(磷虾)", text)
    if m and current(
        text[
            max(text.rfind("。", 0, m.start()), text.rfind("；", 0, m.start()))
            + 1 : m.end()
        ]
    ):
        add(
